title: Native Ad Graphic Designer
description:
We are a growing DTC e-commerce brand in the health and wellness space, and we’re looking for a highly skilled Graphic Designer who specializes in high-performing native-style ads for Meta/Facebook.



We are not looking for a traditional static ad designer focused on polished, branded graphics.



We need someone who understands how to create raw, native, “ugly” ads that blend naturally into the feed, create curiosity, stop the scroll, and generate clicks.



To be considered, you must include the word “NATIVES” in the title of your application.



About the Role



This role is not about making ads look pretty.



It’s about creating native creatives that sell.



You’ll be responsible for creating native ad images on demand whenever new concepts, angles, hooks, or copy need visuals. This is not a role where you’ll be expected to produce a fixed number of images every single day.



At the beginning, you can expect approximately 5–10 hours of work per week. As our creative output increases and we require more work from you, we plan to increase your workload and raise your monthly pay accordingly.



You’ll work closely with our team to turn hooks, angles, concepts, headlines, and full native ad copy into visuals designed specifically for direct-response performance.



A major part of the role is being able to read and understand the copy yourself rather than simply waiting to be told exactly what image to make.



We expect you to understand:



* What the copy is trying to communicate

* What stage of awareness the customer is in

* Who the target avatar is

* What emotions or problems the copy is tapping into

* What type of image would best complement the copy

* What visual would create the most curiosity and click intent

* What would feel believable and native to that specific audience



You should be able to take a piece of native ad copy, understand the marketing strategy behind it, and independently determine the most appropriate visual direction for the target customer.



If you understand direct-response marketing, customer psychology, native advertising, the DTC space, and curiosity-driven design, this role is for you.



What You’ll Be Designing



Your primary focus will be native-style image ads, including:



* Raw, unpolished, feed-blending image ads

* Screenshot-style creatives

* Notes-app-style creatives

* Text-message / WhatsApp-style creatives

* Article / advertorial-style creatives

* News-style and editorial-style creatives

* Headline-driven clickbait ads

* UGC-style still images

* AI-generated lifestyle and scenario imagery

* Curiosity-driven images that intentionally feel organic

* Hook-first scroll stoppers designed specifically for cold traffic



The goal is not to make every creative look professionally designed.



The goal is to make every creative feel native, clickable, believable, and aligned with the copy and target avatar.



What You’ll Own



Native Creative Execution



Create attention-grabbing native ad images whenever new creative concepts are ready to launch.



You will receive ad copy, hooks, angles, references, or briefs from our team and will be expected to turn them into the most strategically appropriate native visuals.



Sometimes we may provide a very clear visual direction.



Other times, we expect you to read the copy, understand the customer, and come up with the visual concept yourself.



The ideal person does not just ask:



> “What image do you want me to make?”



They think:



> “What image would make this exact person stop scrolling and want to know more?”



Marketing & Avatar Understanding



We expect you to have a strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and direct response.



You should be able to identify the core:



* Hook

* Problem

* Desire

* Emotional driver

* Mechanism

* Curiosity gap

* Target customer

* Stage of awareness



You should then translate that understanding into a visual that makes sense for the copy.



For example, a native image targeting a 55-year-old woman dealing with a specific health concern should not necessarily use the same aesthetic, imagery, or visual language as an ad targeting a 25-year-old beauty customer.



The creative needs to feel like it was made for the person seeing it.



DTC Creative Research



We expect you to have a strong understanding of the DTC e-commerce advertising space and actively keep up with what is currently working.



At least once per week, we expect you to spend time reviewing Meta Ads Library and studying the creative output of successful DTC brands.



This includes looking at:



* What native ad formats brands are currently pushing

* What types of images are appearing repeatedly

* How brands are making their ads blend into the feed

* New screenshot, UGC, editorial, testimonial, and advertorial formats

* How brands are visualizing different customer problems

* What visual styles appear to be getting scaled

* New trends that could be adapted to our own brands



We can provide you with an initial list of brands to regularly monitor, but we expect you to take ownership of your learning.



You should be naturally curious and willing to discover additional brands, competitors, and creative trends yourself rather than limiting your research to the exact references we provide.



We want someone who is constantly asking:



> “What are strong DTC brands doing right now, and what can I learn from it?”



Continuous Improvement



We expect your native ad output to improve over time.



As you study more brands, see more performance data, work across more avatars, and understand our markets better, your ability to choose the right visuals should become increasingly strategic.



You should actively build your own understanding of:



* Winning native formats

* Visual patterns

* Different customer avatars

* Different markets

* Click psychology

* DTC creative trends

* What makes certain native visuals feel believable

* What makes an image feel too much like an advertisement



We value designers who are eager to learn and improve, not people who simply complete assigned tasks and stop thinking about the craft.



AI Integration



Use AI tools extensively where they help improve speed, variety, and creative quality.



You should be comfortable using AI to:



* Generate realistic people and environments

* Create lifestyle imagery

* Produce unusual or curiosity-driven visual concepts

* Modify existing images

* Generate multiple visual directions quickly

* Build base assets that can then be edited into finished native creatives



You should be able to take an AI-generated image and turn it into something that feels believable, native, and commercially usable, rather than obviously AI-generated.



Testing & Iteration



When required, create multiple variations around a concept for testing across:



* Images

* Visual angles

* Layouts

* Native formats

* Headline presentation

* Framing

* Levels of polish

* Different ways of representing the same core idea



As performance data comes back, we may ask you to create further iterations around winning concepts.



You should be comfortable using performance feedback to improve future creative decisions.



Systematization



When a native format performs well, we want you to help turn it into a repeatable creative framework that can be adapted across new hooks, avatars, markets, and products.



Platform Optimization



Ensure creatives are properly optimized for Meta and other paid-social placements, including maintaining required dimensions and aspect ratios such as 1:1 when specified.



Who You Are



* 1+ year of experience creating direct-response ads for DTC e-commerce brands

* Available for approximately 5–10 hours per week initially

* Interested in growing into a larger role as our creative needs increase

* Strong understanding of native advertising and direct-response design

* Strong understanding of marketing fundamentals and customer psychology

* Able to read native ad copy and independently determine the strongest visual direction

* Understands how creative should change depending on the target avatar

* Familiar with the DTC e-commerce advertising ecosystem

* Comfortable regularly researching creatives through Meta Ads Library

* Naturally curious about what successful brands and advertisers are testing

* Proactively looks for new brands, trends, and examples to learn from

* Understands exactly what makes an image feel clickable in a feed environment

* Comfortable deliberately creating ads that feel raw, organic, or imperfect

* Highly skilled with AI image-generation and editing tools

* Experienced with Photoshop, Figma, Canva, or similar design software

* Strong image manipulation and compositing ability

* Able to take a concept and execute it independently with minimal direction

* Fast, reliable, and organized

* Excellent communicator with a track record of meeting deadlines

* Understands that native/ugly ≠ lazy — it is a deliberate performance strategy

* More interested in whether an ad converts than whether it wins a design award



Bonus — Nice to Have



* Experience using AI tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, ChatGPT image generation, Flux, or similar

* Previous experience specifically creating native Meta/Facebook ads

* Background working with health, beauty, wellness, or supplement brands

* Experience designing creatives for advertorial funnels

* Familiarity with Meta ad performance metrics and creative feedback loops

* Understanding of CTR, CPC, CPA, CVR, and ROAS

* Basic understanding of direct-response copywriting

* Experience identifying and iterating on winning creative patterns

* Experience conducting competitor and creative research through Meta Ads Library



You’ll Thrive Here If…



* You believe good design = design that converts

* You understand why native ads can outperform polished brand creatives

* You naturally think about why someone would stop scrolling and click

* You enjoy understanding the strategy and psychology behind the copy you’re designing for

* You’re capable of coming up with your own visual concepts rather than needing every creative completely mapped out for you

* You regularly study what other DTC brands are doing

* You actively look for new creative trends instead of waiting for someone else to show them to you

* You enjoy learning about different customers, markets, and avatars

* You don’t get emotionally attached to designs

* You’re comfortable killing losing concepts and iterating on winners

* You understand that sometimes a raw screenshot or simple native image will outperform a beautifully designed advertisement

* You dislike unnecessary over-design

* You want your work to have a measurable impact on revenue

* You want the opportunity to take on more responsibility as the company grows



Workload & Growth



This role will begin at approximately 5–10 hours per week, with native ads created on demand based on our current creative needs.



We are looking for someone we can work with long term, not simply a freelancer for occasional one-off tasks.



As our brands and creative operation continue to grow, we expect the amount of work available to increase.



When we require a larger commitment from you, we will increase your monthly compensation to reflect the additional workload and responsibility.



The ideal person can eventually develop from someone executing native visuals into someone who deeply understands our customers, identifies strong visual concepts independently, spots emerging creative trends, and contributes to the broader creative strategy.



Growth Path



Native Ads Designer → Senior Native Ads Designer → Lead Designer → Creative Strategist



To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume / CV

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples specifically showing native, ugly, direct-response, or feed-blending advertising

4. Examples demonstrating your ability to use AI-generated imagery in commercial creatives

5. If available, examples of ads you created that actually performed, including relevant performance metrics

6. A short explanation of how you would read a piece of native ad copy and d
 what image should accompany it

7. A short explanation of how you currently research and keep up with DTC creative trends



Important



Include “NATIVES” in the title of your application or your application will not be considered.

title: Direct response video editor for DTC brand
description:
Hiring: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs, remaking ads in different languages from reference video + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)



DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$200k/month in revenue



Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type:



Read this part first



We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice."



We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it.



If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading.



Who we are



We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the
 flows — the video.



That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days.



We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship.



How this role starts (please read carefully)



This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate.



We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically.



From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work.



To be clear about what we're offering:



Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works.

Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly.

Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors.



We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time.



If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it.



What you'll actually be making

1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters)



The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide.



You'll be responsible for:



Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof

Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell.



Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage.



Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover



Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments



Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO



2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form)



We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives.



You'll take a script and:



Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it)

Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools

Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio

Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips

Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats

3. Short form paid ads



Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing.



4. Market ports — rebuilding a winning video in another language



We sell in several markets, and a video that wins in one of them is the cheapest new creative we will ever get. So a meaningful part of this role is taking a proven ad and rebuilding it for another country.



To be clear about what this is: the visuals do not change. Same shots, same order, same cuts, same on-screen graphics, same end card. You are not re-editing the ad. You are replacing the language inside it and putting everything back exactly where it was.



You'll be responsible for:



Swapping the voiceover to the new language, generated or supplied, and matching the delivery and energy of the original — a flat VO on a proven edit kills it just as dead as a bad cut.



Re-timing the edit to the new VO. This is the part people underestimate. The same script runs a different length in every language — German and Finnish run long, English runs short — so the audio no longer lands on the cuts. You have to absorb that difference across the timeline without breaking the pacing and without moving the beat where the reveal lands. Stretching every clip by four percent is not the answer.



Removing baked-in on-screen text and replacing it in the new language. Clean removal, matched background, no smeared patch where the old text was. Badly removed text is the single most obvious tell that an ad was ported.



Rebuilding subtitles from scratch against the new VO. Not auto-generated and shipped — checked word by word against the script, re-timed, no gaps, nothing flashing past in a quarter of a second.



Catching every leftover frame of the source language. Packaging in a product shot, a price tag, a browser tab in a screen recording, a subtitle burned into a stock clip, a review screenshot, the end card. One missed frame and the whole ad reads as a copy, which is the exact thing our copy warns customers about.



Keeping brand assets correct per market — including the fact that our name is spelled differently depending on the country.



Done well, this is the highest-return work in the company: a winner that took weeks to find gets a second and third market in a day or two. We will ask you to do a lot of it.



What we need you to be good at



Non-negotiable:



Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d
 everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat.

Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll,

Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop.

Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought.

Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game.

Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days.



Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents:



Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better

AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram

Voice: ElevenLabs or similar

Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific

Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching

Removing text from video: Vmake



Nice to have:



You've written or restructured direct response scripts before

You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche

You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version

You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting

Who this is NOT for

Editors who only work from supplied assets

People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick

"Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell

Anyone who needs to be chased for updates

Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work.

What you get

A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you.

Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good.

Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan.

Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner.

Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you.

Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval.

How to apply



Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter.



Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically:

At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut

At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred)

Short form paid ads if you have them

For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have).

Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong.

Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week.

Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided.

Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: TikTok Shop & Affiliate Manager
description:
BY FAY | Remote



BY FAY is a Netherlands-based beauty brand and professional nail supplier. We are looking for an experienced TikTok Shop specialist who can build our shop from scratch, prepare it for launch and develop a network of creators who generate sales.



We do not currently have a TikTok Shop. You will be responsible for the complete process: account setup, Shopify integration, product listings, creator recruitment, affiliate management and ongoing performance.



We need someone who has done this before and can work independently.



About the first launch



Our upcoming collection includes:



* 18 handmade Nail Jewel styles.

* 100 pieces per style.

* Prices ranging from €9.95 to €14.95 excluding VAT.

* Easy application and a time-saving benefit for nail professionals.

* A premium finishing detail that creates opportunities for demonstrations, styling videos and creator collaborations.



This collection will be the starting point for developing TikTok Shop as a sales channel for BY FAY.



Your responsibilities



1. Complete TikTok Shop setup



Take ownership of setting up a functioning shop that is ready to accept and fulfil orders.



This includes:



* Checking seller eligibility and the requirements for our market.

* Providing one clear checklist of the business documents and information needed.

* Managing the setup and verification process, coordinating with us where owner action is required.

* Configuring seller information, payment details, shipping, returns and customer-service settings.

* Setting up the shop’s branding and connecting the appropriate TikTok account.

* Resolving onboarding issues and communicating any blockers promptly.

* Testing the customer journey and operational setup before launch.



2. Shopify integration and order management



Our existing webshop runs on Shopify. You will be responsible for establishing and testing the appropriate connection between Shopify and TikTok Shop.



Your work should cover:



* Product and variant mapping.

* Accurate inventory synchronisation.

* Correct prices and product information.

* Order transfer and fulfilment workflows.

* Shipping and tracking updates.

* Identifying and resolving synchronisation errors.

* Clear instructions for the team on handling TikTok Shop orders.



With limited quantities per style, accurate stock management is essential.



3. Product listings and merchandising



Create complete, professional product listings that reflect the BY FAY brand and help customers make purchasing decisions.



This includes:



* Product titles, descriptions, categories and attributes.

* Correct prices, quantities and variations.

* Clear information on what each purchase includes.

* Product images, application visuals and video requirements.

* Application and care information based on verified product instructions.

* Selecting suitable products to feature during the launch.

* Recommending bundles where commercially appropriate.

* Resolving listing issues and monitoring product approval status.



You will coordinate with our content team for assets and provide clear briefs when additional material is needed.



4. Creator research and recruitment



Build a relevant creator network for the launch and future campaigns.



You will:



* Find nail, beauty and manicure creators whose audiences match our customers.

* Assess content quality, audience relevance, engagement and available sales performance.

* Prioritise creators who can demonstrate the product clearly and credibly.

* Conduct personalised outreach and manage follow-ups.

* Negotiate collaboration terms within agreed budgets and commission limits.

* Coordinate samples, delivery details and publishing timelines.

* Maintain an organised creator pipeline with contact details, status and next actions.



We expect active recruitment and relationship management, not simply a spreadsheet of creator names.



5. Affiliate programme management



Set up and manage the affiliate programme from recruitment through performance review.



Responsibilities include:



* Recommending commission structures based on our margins.

* Setting up appropriate creator collaborations.

* Managing product samples within an agreed budget.

* Preparing clear briefs covering product benefits, demonstrations and calls to action.

* Following up on sample receipt, content creation and publication.

* Tracking which creators publish and which generate sales.

* Building longer-term relationships with effective creators.

* Recommending improvements or ending ineffective collaborations.



Samples, fees and commissions must be tracked so we understand the cost and value of each partnership.



6. Launch and content coordination



Develop a practical TikTok Shop launch plan that works alongside our wider BY FAY campaign.



You will:



* Plan the shop launch around our Inner Circle early-access schedule.

* Coordinate product availability, creator content and launch communications.

* Brief our content team on videos needed for the shop.

* Develop concepts for application demonstrations, before-and-after videos, styling and product close-ups.

* Coordinate shoppable content and assess whether LIVE shopping is appropriate.

* Identify content worth testing further.

* Recommend paid promotion where justified, with approval before spending.



Our team can support content production. You must provide the commercial direction, clear briefs and follow-through.



7. Reporting and optimisation



Provide a concise weekly report showing what has been completed, what is working and what needs to change.



Track relevant metrics such as:



* Shop sales and orders.

* Product performance.

* Product clicks and conversion.

* Average order value.

* Creators contacted, responses and confirmed collaborations.

* Samples sent and content published.

* Sales generated by individual creators.

* Affiliate commissions and other campaign costs.

* Cancellations, returns and operational issues.

* Profitability based on available cost data.



Success will be assessed on execution, sales and profitability—not views or follower growth alone.



What we expect in your first month



Week 1 — Assessment and setup



* Review our products, Shopify setup and launch requirements.

* Provide a clear implementation plan and document checklist.

* Start seller onboarding and shop configuration.

* Begin creator research and prepare your outreach approach.



Week 2 — Listings and testing



* Prepare the product listings and required assets.

* Configure and test the Shopify connection.

* Check inventory, order and fulfilment workflows.

* Begin creator outreach and collaboration discussions.



Week 3 — Creator activation and launch preparation



* Confirm initial creator collaborations.

* Coordinate samples, briefs and publishing schedules.

* Complete shop checks and resolve outstanding issues.

* Prepare a detailed launch calendar.



Week 4 — Launch and optimisation



* Launch once the shop is approved and operationally ready.

* Coordinate creator content and monitor orders.

* Resolve issues quickly.

* Report initial results and propose the next growth priorities.



This is an indicative timeline. In your application, explain what is realistic based on your experience, including platform approval times and other dependencies.



Required experience



You must have:



* Direct experience setting up and managing TikTok Shops.

* Practical experience recruiting and managing affiliate creators.

* Evidence of previous shop or campaign results.

* Experience with ecommerce operations and Shopify integrations.

* An understanding of commissions, product margins and campaign profitability.

* Strong written communication and creator outreach skills.

* The ability to manage the project independently and keep accurate records.



Experience with TikTok Shop in the Netherlands or other EU markets is strongly preferred. Beauty, nail or cosmetics experience is an advantage.



How you should work



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes initiative and researches solutions independently.

* Gives clear recommendations rather than waiting for instructions at every step.

* Communicates blockers early and proposes solutions.

* Works to agreed deadlines and follows up consistently.

* Collaborates effectively with our content and ecommerce team.

* Keeps accounts, creator records and campaign information organised and accessible to BY FAY.

* Obtains approval before committing to advertising spend, paid collaborations or unagreed costs.



How to apply



Please include:



1. Relevant TikTok Shop experience: which shops you worked on, the markets involved and your exact responsibilities.

2. Setup examples: explain a shop you built from scratch and the main challenges you resolved.

3. Creator recruitment experience: how you find, approach and activate suitable affiliates.

4. Results: provide examples with a timeframe and explain whether sales came from organic content, affiliates, LIVE shopping or paid advertising.

5. Supporting evidence: shop links, case studies or screenshots, with confidential information removed where necessary.

6. Your first-month plan: how you would approach the BY FAY setup and creator recruitment.

7. Availability and rate: your start date, weekly availability and proposed pricing, distinguishing setup work from ongoing management.



Please do not apply if you have no direct TikTok Shop and affiliate creator experience. General social media management, content creation or personal TikTok use alone does not qualify you for this role. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate relevant work and take ownership from day one.

title: Fitness Sales Appointment Setter (Full-Time) | US Fitness Coaching Brand
description:
We are a US-based online fitness coaching business. Our founder is a national-level physique competitor and former aerospace engineer, and we help clients transform their health through 16-week coaching programs. We have 125,000+ engaged followers across TikTok,
, Instagram, and YouTube. Your job is to turn that audience into booked sales calls.



**THE ROLE**



You will be the first human touchpoint for people interested in our coaching. You start genuine conversations in the DMs, build rapport over time, and book warm, qualified leads directly into our founder's Calendly.



This is a relationship-first role. We do NOT want spammy copy-paste blasting. We provide proven templates; you personalize every message and let conversations develop naturally. Rapport first, appointment second.



**WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY**



- Send 100+ outbound DMs per day across our platforms

- Personalize our message templates for each person based on their profile and engagement

- Nurture replies at a natural pace and move warm leads toward a sales call

- Book interested leads directly into Calendly

- Write a short summary of every conversation that leads to a booked call

- Log your daily numbers (DMs sent, replies, conversations, calls booked)



**COMPENSATION**



- Performance based commission on booked calls that turns into a closed sale. Commission scales with the program tier the client purchases: closing our premium program pays roughly triple what our entry program pays, so nurturing quality leads directly increases your income

- You receive a conversion report so you always know exactly which of your bookings closed and what you've earned

- Total earnings for a consistent performer land well above typical full-time setter rates, with no hard ceiling on the commission side



Note: commission is paid on CLOSED sales, not just booked calls. This role rewards setters who book genuinely interested people, not calendar-stuffers.



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word MACKEREL as the very first word and the subject of the message. Applications that do not start with MACKEREL will be deleted without being read. This is how we filter for people who pay attention to detail, which is the #1 skill in this role.



**REQUIREMENTS**



- Excellent spoken and written English with a natural, conversational American tone

- Must be available to work US hours: 6AM-2PM MST at least. This is a firm requirement; our audience is most active during US afternoons and evenings, and fast reply speed during those hours is core to this role. You must be highly available on chat during these times as well. No exceptions. 

- Experience as an appointment setter in the fitness space, DM setter, or chat-based sales role (fitness, coaching, or online business niche)

- Comfortable with high daily volume without losing warmth or quality

- Full-time availability, reliable internet, strong self-management

- Familiar with 

- Manychat and Meta Business Suite is a plus



**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**



- Not a hard-sell or pressure role. If you burn leads by rushing them, this is not the right fit.

- Not a content creation or design role.

- You do not close sales on calls. You book them; our founder closes them.



**HOW TO APPLY**



Your application must include ALL of the following, in this order:



1. The word MACKEREL as the very first word of your application

2. A short intro: your setter/DM experience and the niches pertinent to this role 

3. Your response to this scenario, written exactly as you would send it: A woman comments "I need to lose fat". Write your opening DM to her.

4. Your earliest start date and confirmation that you can work full-time on the stated US hours schedule



Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.

title: SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required
description:
We're Recruiting a SEO Specialist with Web Development Experience Required



Company: Allied Health Media

Job Type: Full-time

Work Setup: Remote

Working Hours: Mon-Sat / 9AM-PM UK time


 



About Allied Health Media



Allied Health Media (Allied Health Media Limited) is a UK healthcare marketing agency, headquartered in London, founded by Abhay Patel in 2022. It helps private medical consultants grow their practices through AI-driven visibility and patient acquisition — ranking them top-3 on Google Maps and AI search to drive self-pay patient calls. Its core offerings include the 12-month Practice Authority Accelerator program, a website design/build service with ongoing retainer, and the Medical Authority Media Series for video and personal branding, all delivered through an in-house team spanning growth, CS, SEO, production, design, and development.



About the Role



As our SEO Specialist, you'll own the organic search performance of a portfolio of client websites, most of them in healthcare. That means running full technical and on-page audits, catching crawling, indexing, and architecture issues before they hurt rankings, and keeping Core Web Vitals, structured data, and site health in good shape. You'll turn findings into clear, actionable tasks for developers and content teams, then verify the fixes actually landed correctly on the live site — not just take someone's word for it. You'll also track performance through GA4 and Search Console, investigate unusual traffic or ranking shifts, and report on what's working, what isn't, and what should happen next. Because our clients operate in healthcare, you'll need to apply extra care and sound judgement around medical content accuracy, not just chase quick wins.



Do Not Apply If...



You rely solely on automated tool scores instead of professional judgement

You don't follow through to confirm that requested fixes were actually implemented correctly

You're uncomfortable explaining technical SEO issues to non-technical team members

You cut corners on accuracy, especially with medical/healthcare content

You need close supervision to manage multiple client websites and priorities

You're not comfortable learning new SEO tools and platforms.

You don't have a background or practical experience in web development.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct comprehensive technical SEO audits, covering crawling, indexing, rendering, and site architecture.

Review and optimise XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, and URL structures.

Monitor Core Web Vitals, page speed, and mobile usability.

Review and troubleshoot structured data and schema markup.

Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues, and investigate unusual changes.

Support website migrations, redesigns, and staging-to-live launches.

Optimise on-page elements — titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking.

Identify duplicate, thin, or competing pages and recommend consolidation or redirection.

Review and QA completed SEO and development work across desktop, tablet, and mobile before sign-off.

Retest and verify that requested fixes have been implemented correctly on the live site.

Monitor organic traffic, rankings, and conversions via GA4, and prepare clear performance reports.

Coordinate with developers, designers, and content teams — writing clear, actionable SEO tasks.

Apply extra care, accuracy, and professional judgement when working with healthcare and medical content.



Skills and Tools Required



At least two years of practical SEO experience.

Strong knowledge of technical SEO and on-page optimisation.

Experience conducting detailed website audits and prioritising fixes by impact.

Understanding of crawling, indexing, canonicalisation, redirects, and URL structures.

Experience with structured data/schema markup and Core Web Vitals.

Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS, plus basic HTML/CSS.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Experience working with developers and verifying completed fixes.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical issues simply.

Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

Experience with SEO platforms such as Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, or Semrush.

Familiarity with PageSpeed Insights/Lighthouse, Looker Studio, and schema validation tools.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based package tailored to your experience and track record, with room to grow as you take on more client responsibility. This is a long-term opportunity with a stable, growing agency — not a short-term contract — and we reward accuracy, reliability, and great work with real career progression.



Why Join Us?



Work across a real portfolio of client websites, including meaningful healthcare projects where your work genuinely matters.

Join a fast-growing team where your audits and recommendations directly shape client results.

Flexible, remote-friendly setup with a supportive, collaborative team culture.

Room to grow into more senior SEO or strategy roles as the company scales.

Exposure to a variety of tools, platforms, and industries — never the same day twice.

A team that values professional judgement, accuracy, and follow-through over vanity metrics.





Ready to Join a Fast-Growing Team?

If you take pride in thorough audits, clear recommendations, and following through until it's actually fixed, we'd love to hear from you. Apply below and show us what you can do.

title: Multi-Entity Bookkeeper
description:
Position: Full-Charge Bookkeeper – Multiple Small Businesses



Employment Type: Part-Time / Contract

Schedule: Approximately 5–10 hours per week to start, with potential for additional hours as the businesses grow

Work Arrangement: Remote / Flexible



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, dependable Full-Charge Bookkeeper to manage the financial records for multiple small businesses and LLCs.



This person will be responsible for keeping each company's financial activity organized, accurate, and completely separate while helping us establish professional bookkeeping systems that can scale as the businesses grow.



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply enter transactions. The ideal candidate can review accounts, identify problems, clean up existing books, maintain accurate records, and prepare organized financial reports for management and our CPA.



Responsibilities



- Maintain bookkeeping for multiple LLCs and small businesses

- Set up and maintain each company properly in QuickBooks Online

- Categorize income and expenses accurately

- Reconcile business checking, savings, and credit-card accounts

- Review transactions regularly for errors, duplicates, or incorrect classifications

- Maintain accurate records of owner contributions and owner draws

- Track accounts receivable and customer payments

- Track accounts payable and business expenses

- Assist with invoicing and payment records when necessary

- Maintain clean documentation and financial records

- Prepare monthly Profit & Loss Statements

- Prepare Balance Sheets and basic cash-flow reports

- Provide monthly financial summaries to the owner

- Keep each business's financial records completely separate

- Assist with transitioning or organizing information currently maintained in Wave and other systems into QuickBooks

- Work with our CPA and tax professionals when financial information or reports are needed

- Help prepare bookkeeping records for tax filing

- Identify missing documentation or bookkeeping issues before they become larger problems

- Help establish repeatable bookkeeping procedures for new businesses as they are added



What We're Looking For



- Experience with QuickBooks Online

- Experience bookkeeping for multiple businesses or LLCs

- Strong understanding of bank and credit-card reconciliation

- Ability to prepare Profit & Loss Statements and Balance Sheets

- Understanding of owner draws, owner contributions, and business expenses

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

- Ability to keep confidential financial information secure

- Clear written and verbal communication

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

- Comfortable working directly with a business owner, CPA, and other professional advisors



Preferred Qualifications



- 3+ years of bookkeeping experience

- Experience working with service-based small businesses

- Experience cleaning up or correcting existing books

- Experience migrating bookkeeping records from Wave or similar systems into QuickBooks

- QuickBooks Online certification is a plus

- Experience supporting multiple LLCs or related companies is strongly preferred



Businesses



The bookkeeper will initially support several small businesses operating in industries including:



- Information technology and managed services

- Lawn care and snow removal

- Cleaning services

- Additional future business ventures and investments



What Success Looks Like



Within the first several months, we want:



- Every business properly organized in QuickBooks

- Business and personal transactions clearly separated

- Bank and credit-card accounts reconciled

- Previous bookkeeping issues identified and corrected

- Monthly financial reports available for each company

- Books organized and ready for our CPA

- A repeatable bookkeeping system that can support additional companies as we grow



We are looking for someone interested in building a long-term professional relationship with a growing group of businesses. Hours may increase as the companies expand.

- QA desktop, mobile, cart, and checkout



Meta Launches



- Build campaigns using our standard structures

- Upload creatives and copy

- Select the correct Page, Instagram account, pixel/dataset, URL, and budget

- Apply naming conventions

- Confirm tracking and publishing

- Verify the campaign is actually delivering



Launch QA



You will be expected to catch preventable mistakes such as:



- wrong pricing

- wrong product or variant

- broken links

- old copy left in templates

- wrong Meta identity or pixel

- incorrect budget

- missing tracking

- creative/copy mismatches

- mobile formatting issues



Launch Tracking



Every product should always have:



- current stage

- current status

- next action

- due date

- blockers clearly surfaced



We should never need to ask:



“What’s happening with this launch?”



The tracker should already tell us.



Who We’re Looking For



The right person is:



- extremely detail-oriented

- organized

- reliable

- comfortable following SOPs and checklists

- a fast learner

- clear in written communication

- comfortable with repetitive execution

- proactive about flagging blockers

- willing to ask instead of guessing



You should be the type of person who catches the wrong link, wrong price, or wrong pixel before anyone else notices.



That matters more to us than an impressive resume.



Nice-to-Have Experience



Experience with any of these is helpful:



- Shopify

- Meta Ads Manager

- ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude

- Google Sheets / Drive

- Canva / Photoshop / Photopea / basic image editing

- Ecommerce operations



You do not need to be:



- a senior media buyer

- copywriter

- creative strategist

- Head of Growth



During Slower Launch Periods



When launch volume is lower, you may help with:



- product-page QA

- campaign cleanup

- tracking checks

- creative organization

- competitor/ad-library research

- SOP updates

- store audits

- preparing future product templates



How Success Is Measured



You will be measured mainly on:



- clean launches

- on-time execution

- preventable error rate

- speed from approved product → live test

- tracker accuracy

- how little founder intervention is required



The goal is simple:



Take an approved product and get it live correctly with minimal founder involvement.



Compensation



Competitive fixed monthly pay based on:



- experience

- Shopify/Meta familiarity

- work-sample performance

- availability



There is also room for performance bonuses based on execution quality and reliability.



We are open to starting with a paid trial and moving into a long-term role for the right person.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction

2. Your Shopify experience

3. Your Meta Ads Manager experience

4. Your experience using AI tools

5. One example of catching a mistake before it became a bigger problem

6. A 2-3 minute Loom introducing yourself and showing how you organize your work



At the very top of your application, write:



LAUNCH



Applications without this will not be reviewed.

title: Founder Led Content Video Editor
description:
Not just another "clipping" job 



If you love short form content and get frustrated seeing mass produced clips that don't understand psychology, story telling and creating emotion ... this is for you. 



We're looking for someone who loves searching through content for the part that tells a story, the hook that most people don't see and can craft a reel that makes people actually feel something. Someone who wants to create content they're actually proud of. 



A good clip is the difference between a great conversation nobody watches and content that builds someone's business, brand and community and that is what we create. 



About Project C



After landing every podcast we've ever launched on the top charts, and working with some of Australia's favourite creators, we learned exactly what separates good content from content that actually builds your business, brand and community.



We spent years searching for a studio that understood what creators need ... then we stopped searching and started building.



We wanted to build a space that inspired every person who walked in the door, that encouraged better conversation and didn't just make you sound great but make you look and feel your best as well.

The studio has Netflix Approved 4K Cameras, the Microphones the best podcasters in the world use, lighting that makes you look like you've slept 10+ hours (even when you've only slept 4) and a team that are obsessed with helping you create content you can't wait to share.



About You.



You love social media, learning the algorthims and creating content 

You edit for retention and engagement. You understand pace, tension, and why people keep watching instead of swiping.

You check your work thoroughly

You obsess over the small details. Framing, eye levels, making sure everything is optimised for the platform it is posted on and no typos

You are proactive. If you think we should change a process or there is a better way to film or feedback a host needs to hear you tell us. 

You will always met a deadline or proactively tell us if there are ever any issues 

You love creating processes and structures that make everyones lives easier

You are proactive - if you see a way for something to be done better ... you do it.

You take feedback and come back sharper. You are not precious about a cut, you are precious about the result.

You have worked with a studio or agency before on high volume work 

You want to grow with a business and have opportunities to learn and upskill

You are an excellent communicator.

BONUS - You love AI and are already building and learning to use AI tools to take your editing process to the next level 





Our Non-Negotiables



You are not an agency and you are not outsourcing the edit to someone else. You may have the opportunity to grow a team under you later, but we are hiring one editor who is excited to grow with us.

Excellent communication. If a deadline is going to be missed, you are stuck, or you need a better brief, you tell us ASAP.

You never hide problems.

You hit deadlines. 

You are proactive and make calls without being told, but you ask questions rather than guessing.



What you will own



- Cutting the podcasts filmed at our studio into finished long-form episodes that hold attention start to finish.

- Founder-led content. Taking a client's raw footage and shaping it into clips, brand pieces and story-driven edits that make them look like the authority they are.

- Short-form built for reach. Hooks, pacing, captions and clips engineered to be watched, shared and saved.

- Building your own edit templates, presets and SOPs (with AI to assist) so the work gets faster and more consistent over time.



There are opportunities for additional work in thumbnails, carousel creation, or building AI editing workflows to fill additional hours. Tell us what you love, and if it is the right fit we would love to train you and get you building other skills too.



What we offer

- Flexible working hours with a requirement to be available for some crossover in Australian business hours, 9am to 5pm AEST.

- Opportunity for growth in salary, skills and opportunity 

- Training in the AI production systems we are building. That skill will be worth more to you in three years than this job pays today.

- A long-term seat. We are not filling a gap. We are hiring the editor who shapes how Project C's content looks long term. 



Must haves



- Two or more years editing video, ideally podcast, social or branded content for a Western audience.

- A showreel or portfolio. This one is non-negotiable: we want to see both short-form clips and at least one longer, story-driven edit.

- Fluent in editing tools like Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve. Both is a bonus. CapCut, Descript, After Effects and Frame.io are all a plus.

- Excellent written English.

- Reliable power, internet and a computer that can handle 4K video files, with a backup plan. You will be moving large video files, so great internet is a must.

- Full or part time, tell us what you are after.

- Extra points for colour grading, sound, motion graphics, thumbnail design, or experience editing for founder and creator brands.



How to apply



Fill out this form [Tally link] and include your showreel.

title: Long-term YouTube script writer (with a path to channel manager)
description:
Long-term YouTube script writer (with a path to channel manager)



I run YouTube channels about making money online with AI, AI tools and tutorials, and YouTube growth and Shorts. My main channel is [ 
  ]. I'm looking for one person to write my video scripts and, over time, take over more of the channel operation.



The role today



You write full scripts for my long-form videos. Every video follows the same six steps:



Research the tool or topic



Research what people want to watch



Find the viewer's real questions and research the answers



Build the structure



Record the screen clips and generations the video needs



Write the script



Each step goes to me for approval before you start the next one. I give you a written SOP that covers the process and how the scripts should sound.



Pay is $80 to $100 per script, depending on the video.



Where it can go



If the scripts work and we work well together, I want to hand over more of the process:



Finding and validating video ideas



Writing the scripts



Handling the sponsor process



Checking the editors' work



Managing the channel on a revenue share basis



We'll agree the revenue share terms once we've worked on real videos together. I'm looking for someone who stays for years.



What I'm looking for



Strong written English. The scripts are spoken voiceover, so they need to sound natural read aloud.



Comfort with AI tools (video and image generators, chatbots) and with screen recording your own tests. You'll create the footage for most videos.



Fast turn arounds - with research and script it should take you 3 days at max



A script writen by you - not by AI, all the AI phrases and sentence structure is spotted by me immediatelly and I will not approve this work



The habit of checking sources. Every number and claim in a script needs a link and a date. I don't publish hype or invented figures.



Honest verdicts. If a tool gives a bad result, the script says so.



Reliability. You send each step on time, take feedback well and apply it to the next video without being told twice.



Bonus: experience with YouTube research (vidIQ or similar), or a channel of your own.



How to apply



Send everything in one message. It should take about 20 minutes.



Your pitch. Pitch 3 video ideas for my channel that you think would perform well. For each one, send the title you would use and a link to an existing video that proves people want this topic. Add one sentence on why you think it will work.



Why it worked. Pick one YouTube video from the last 6 months that got far more views than its channel usually gets. Send the link. In 4 to 5 sentences, explain why it worked: the title, the thumbnail and the first 30 seconds.



Structure. Take the idea you like best from task 1 and give me the video as segments. For each segment, write the problem the viewer has, the fix, and how the footage would be made. Write the word "checked" at the end of your message so I know you read all the tasks.



About you. Two lines on your writing experience (links if you have them), your weekly hours and your time zone.



I'll reply to every serious application.



What happens next



The first script is a trial. If it's good, I pay the full rate for it and we keep working together.

title: Project Support Officer / Agile Project Coordinator
description:
Role Overview



I am looking for a highly organised and proactive Project Support Officer / Agile Project Coordinator to support a consultancy delivering multiple technology and transformation projects.



The role will work closely with the lead Project/Programme Manager, providing behind-the-scenes project management, Agile/Scrum and administrative support across several concurrent engagements.



This is primarily an **internal support role with little or no direct client communication**. The successful candidate will help ensure projects are well organised, project information is accurate and up to date, Agile ceremonies are properly prepared, and the Project Manager has the information and materials required to manage delivery effectively.



Key Responsibilities



Agile & Scrum Support



* Support the preparation and administration of Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews/Demos and Retrospectives.

* Prepare **Planning Poker / estimation sessions**, ensuring stories are ready for estimation and capturing outcomes.

* Review sprint backlogs ahead of ceremonies and highlight incomplete, outdated or poorly defined stories/tasks.

* Monitor story status, ownership, estimates, sprint allocation and completion.

* Help identify stories that are missing acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, owners or sufficient detail.

* Track sprint progress and highlight potential delivery risks, blockers, overdue items and carry-over.

* Support analysis of team capacity, utilisation and sprint velocity.

* Prepare sprint metrics, dashboards and summaries for the Project Manager.

* Help maintain Jira/Azure DevOps or equivalent project management tools.

* Assist the Project Manager with general Scrum Master activities and ceremony preparation.



Project Management Support



* Maintain project plans, trackers, RAID logs, action logs, milestone plans and delivery schedules.

* Monitor actions, dependencies, risks, issues and deadlines across multiple projects.

* Review project data and identify discrepancies, missing information or items requiring attention.

* Help maintain accurate resource allocation and capacity information.

* Track progress against milestones and planned delivery dates.

* Prepare weekly project status information and management summaries.

* Support project governance and reporting requirements.

* Maintain organised project documentation and ensure information remains current.

* Follow up internally on outstanding actions and deliverables.



Presentations & Documentation



* Create and maintain professional PowerPoint presentations for project meetings, governance sessions, workshops and management updates.

* Turn raw project information into clear, concise and visually structured slides.

* Prepare project plans, timelines, status reports, meeting packs and other supporting documentation.

* Produce meeting agendas and supporting materials.

* Capture and organise meeting notes, actions and decisions where required.

* Help the Project Manager prepare for important meetings and workshops.



Multi-Project Support



The role will support **multiple projects simultaneously**, so the successful candidate will need to be comfortable switching between different workstreams, priorities and stakeholders.



They will work closely with the lead Project Manager to understand what needs attention each week and independently progress supporting activities.



Skills & Experience



The ideal candidate will have:



* Previous experience as a **Project Support Officer, Project Coordinator, PMO Analyst, Agile Coordinator, Junior Scrum Master** or similar.

* Good understanding of **Agile and Scrum ways of working**.

* Experience working with sprint backlogs, user stories, story points, Planning Poker and Agile ceremonies.

* Experience with **Jira and/or Azure DevOps**.

* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills.

* Ability to create clear project plans, trackers, reports and presentations.

* Strong attention to detail and an ability to spot inconsistencies or missing information.

* Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

* Ability to manage competing priorities across several projects.

* Confidence analysing project information rather than simply administering it.

* Ability to work independently with relatively limited supervision.

* Strong written English and the ability to summarise complex information clearly.

Knowledge of tools such as **Microsoft Project, Confluence, Miro or similar** is required.

Experience in technology, IT infrastructure, software delivery, cloud, telecommunications or digital transformation projects would be advantageous.



Working Relationship



The role will work primarily as an **assistant to the lead Project/Programme Manager**.



The Project Manager will retain responsibility for client relationships, senior stakeholder management, commercial matters and overall project accountability.



The Project Support Officer will focus on ensuring the Project Manager is well prepared and that the underlying project administration, planning, Agile processes, reporting and documentation are organised and maintained to a high standard.



What Success Looks Like



A successful person in this role will make the Project Manager's job significantly easier. Project information will be organised and reliable, ceremonies will be prepared in advance, presentations and plans will be ready when required, outstanding actions will be visible, and potential delivery problems will be identified before they become issues.



The role would suit someone who is **proactive rather than purely administrative** — someone who can look at a sprint backlog or project plan, identify that something does not look right, investigate it and bring it to the Project Manager's attention.

title: Video Editor + Social Media Assistant – Sports Content
description:
## Video Editor + Social Media Assistant – Sports Content



I’m looking for a reliable, creative **Video Editor / Social Media Assistant** to help manage content for my sports social media channels, primarily **Jags Fan Dan** (Jacksonville Jaguars/NFL) and **Jays Fan Dan** (Toronto Blue Jays/MLB).



This will start as a part-time role, but there is potential for more hours and responsibility if we work well together.



### What You’ll Be Doing



Your main responsibility will be turning my raw footage into engaging sports content for:



- YouTube Shorts

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok

- Longer YouTube videos



You will also help with the day-to-day management of the accounts.



Typical responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form vertical videos (9:16)

- Editing occasional longer YouTube videos

- Adding captions/subtitles

- Adding relevant photos, clips, graphics, sound effects and music

- Creating strong hooks and keeping videos fast-paced

- Formatting videos correctly for YouTube, Instagram and TikTok

- Scheduling and uploading posts

- Helping write or format captions, titles, descriptions and hashtags

- Organizing raw footage and completed videos

- Helping keep a consistent posting schedule

- Basic social media management and content organization



I will generally provide the main idea, talking-head footage and direction. I’m looking for someone who can take that footage and quickly turn it into polished, engaging content without making it feel overly edited or artificial.



### Fast Turnaround Is Very Important



Because this is sports content, many videos will be time-sensitive.



There will be situations where I record a video after a game, during breaking news, or when a major story happens and need the finished edit **very quickly**.



For short-form videos, I may need turnaround times of approximately **30 minutes to 2 hours** depending on the situation.



You must be comfortable working quickly while still maintaining good quality.



### U.S. Hours Availability



A major requirement for this role is availability during **U.S. hours**, especially evenings and weekends.



NFL and MLB games often take place during U.S. afternoon and evening hours, and I frequently want content edited and posted shortly after games end.



You do not need to work U.S. hours every day, but you should be available for scheduled windows during important games, breaking news, and other time-sensitive content.



If you are located in the Philippines, this will sometimes mean working **overnight or early-morning Philippine hours**.



Please only apply if you are genuinely comfortable with this schedule.



### The Style I Want



My content is sports fan commentary, not corporate content.



The editing should feel:



- Fast-paced

- Natural

- Funny when appropriate

- Energetic

- Clean

- Designed to keep viewers watching



You should understand how to use things like zooms, cuts, captions, memes, sports footage, screenshots and graphics without overdoing them.



Knowledge of the NFL, MLB or North American sports is a big plus, but it is not required if you are willing to learn.



### Tools



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



- CapCut

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- DaVinci Resolve

- Canva

- YouTube Studio

- Instagram

- TikTok



### What I’m Looking For



I care more about **reliability, speed, communication and good judgment** than having the fanciest editing portfolio.



You should:



- Communicate well in English

- Be available during agreed-upon U.S. hours

- Be capable of very fast turnaround when needed

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Respond quickly when time-sensitive content is being created

- Pay close attention to details

- Be comfortable receiving feedback

- Be able to follow an established editing style

- Be willing to suggest improvements when you have a good idea

- Understand social media trends and short-form content



Ideally, I want someone who can eventually learn my channels well enough that I can send over footage and trust you to handle most of the editing, scheduling and posting process without needing constant direction.



### Schedule



This will initially be a **part-time position**, but the hours may not always follow a traditional schedule.



Some work can be completed flexibly, but game-day and breaking-news content will often require you to be available at specific times during U.S. hours.



Typical high-priority periods may include:



- NFL game days

- MLB games

- Postgame reactions

- Breaking sports news

- Major trades or signings

- Time-sensitive trending stories



There may also be slower days where work can be completed more flexibly.



### How to Apply



Please send me:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Examples of short-form videos you have edited.

3. Examples of sports content you have edited, if you have any.

4. Which editing software you use.

5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate.

6. Your normal working hours in Philippine time.

7. Whether you are comfortable regularly working during U.S. evenings and weekends when needed.

8. Your internet speed.

9. What turnaround time you could typically provide for a 60–90 second short-form video.

10. Put the word **“DUUUVAL”** at the beginning of your application so I know you actually read the entire job posting.



Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application. Tell me briefly why you think you would be a good fit for this specific role.



There will likely be a **paid trial edit** before I hire someone long term.

title: Long-Form YouTube Documentary Editor | AI Visuals + Sound Design
description:
We are building Earth Before Memory, a new English-language YouTube documentary channel focused on prehistoric Earth, extinct animals, ancient oceans, evolution and deep time.



We are looking for ONE long-term editor who can take a detailed production blueprint and turn it into a polished 12–16 minute cinematic documentary.



This is not a basic “cut clips together” editing job.



You should be comfortable handling most of the production process yourself, including:



• Long-form YouTube editing

• AI-generated images and video

• Cinematic still-image animation / parallax

• ElevenLabs voice generation and selecting the best takes

• Music selection

• Sound design

• Maps, diagrams and simple documentary UI

• Visual consistency across many shots

• Basic scientific / visual fact-checking

• Asset sourcing and licensing

• Final audio mix and export



STYLE



The channel should feel like a premium natural-history documentary.



Think:

• cinematic

• intelligent

• immersive

• scientifically believable

• strong pacing

• controlled tension



Do NOT apply if your work mainly looks like:

• generic AI slideshows

• TikTok / Shorts editing

• meme editing

• gaming videos

• excessive transitions or whooshes

• low-quality AI imagery

• basic stock-footage compilations



We already provide a detailed production system including:



• full script

• shot-by-shot edit plan

• pacing targets

• visual prompts

• narration settings

• music / sound direction

• fact-check notes

• brand rules

• quality-control checklist



You are not expected to invent the entire documentary from scratch.



Your job is to EXECUTE the production at a high level.



VOICE



Narration will use ElevenLabs.



You should be able to:

• generate multiple takes

• select the most natural take

• correct pronunciation problems

• maintain consistent pacing

• avoid robotic delivery

• edit narration cleanly



AI VISUALS



You must understand how to keep characters / objects visually consistent across many shots.



For example, one upcoming documentary uses the same small wooden sailboat throughout the entire video.



You must also be able to spot obvious AI problems such as:

• incorrect anatomy

• malformed animals

• unrealistic scale

• duplicated objects

• strange textures

• text artifacts

• inconsistent environments



PAID TEST



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid 75–90 second editing test.



Paid test: $35 USD.



The test includes the same type of production instructions you would receive for a full video.



Only the strongest candidates will move to ongoing production.



FULL VIDEO BUDGET



Initial budget:

$150–$200 USD per finished 12–16 minute documentary.



This can increase if you consistently deliver strong work and can handle the production independently.



We are interested in building a long-term relationship, not hiring for one video.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with:



BEFORE MEMORY



Applications without these words at the beginning will not be considered.



Then answer the following:



1. Send a maximum of 3 portfolio links.



For EACH link, give the exact 20–60 second timestamp you want us to watch.



2. Which piece in your portfolio is closest to cinematic documentary / natural-history YouTube editing, and why?



3. Which AI image and AI video tools have you personally used?



4. Have you worked with ElevenLabs? Explain how you handle multiple takes, pacing and pronunciation.



5. How do you choose music for a documentary scene?



6. Imagine the same wooden boat appears in more than 100 AI-generated shots. How would you keep the boat visually consistent?



7. How would you prevent prehistoric animals from looking anatomically wrong or obviously AI-generated?



8. Can you provide editable project files and an asset / licensing log with every finished video?



9. How long would you need to finish a 12–16 minute documentary once all instructions are provided?



10. What would your rate be per completed 12–16 minute video after the paid test?



Please do not send a long generic cover letter.



We care more about your work, your answers and your attention to detail.



End your application with this exact sentence:



I understand that the paid test is 75–90 seconds and that passing the test does not guarantee ongoing work.
