title: SENIOR YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT PRODUCER
description:
# SENIOR YOUTUBE VIDEO EDITOR & CONTENT PRODUCER



Full-Time | Remote | Philippines



## ABOUT THE COMPANY



Beauty Seek is a growing beauty education platform producing expert interviews about aesthetic procedures, beauty products, wellness and informed consumer decision-making.



We are looking for an experienced, highly dependable Video Editor and Content Producer who can take ownership of the complete post-production process—from correcting the original interview footage through creating and publishing long-form videos, episodes, Shorts, thumbnails, commercials and extended sleep-sound videos.



This is a long-term, full-time position. Excellent written and spoken English is required.



## THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS POSITION



The first responsibility is ensuring that the recorded interview footage looks and sounds professional.



Every other deliverable depends on getting the master footage right.



The editor must independently identify and correct:



* Uneven, quiet, distorted or popping audio.

* Background noise, room echo and inconsistent volume.

* Abrupt noise-gate effects at the beginning of speech.

* Audio and video synchronization problems.

* Poor exposure, inconsistent color and distracting skin tones.

* Framing, cropping, eye-line and speaker-layout problems.

* Unnecessary pauses, repeated answers and weak transitions.

* Visual or audio inconsistencies between separate recording tracks.



The editor must listen to and visually inspect the complete exported video before submitting it. A successful candidate does not rely only on automated tools or wait for someone else to find basic errors.



# PRODUCTION PROCESS



## STAGE 1 — INGEST, IMAGE CORRECTION AND AUDIO CORRECTION



* Download separate Riverside video and audio tracks.

* Confirm that all source files are complete and synchronized.

* Select the best-quality source tracks.

* Clean and balance each speaker’s audio.

* Correct popping, clipping, echo, background noise and inconsistent levels.

* Correct exposure, color, framing and speaker layouts.

* Confirm that the corrected master footage is ready before creating derivative content.

* Escalate corrupted or missing source footage immediately.

* Organize source files and corrected masters in Google Drive.



## STAGE 2 — LONG-FORM INTERVIEW EDITING



* Produce the complete expert interview.

* Follow the approved script and Production Grid.

* Remove unnecessary pauses, repetition and unusable sections.

* Add strong opening hooks and maintain viewer attention.

* Add branded introductions, lower thirds, captions, graphics and transitions.

* Add appropriate B-roll and supporting visual material.

* Protect the accuracy of medical and technical terminology.

* Create a polished, natural interview—not an over-edited social video.

* Prepare the completed video for private YouTube review.



## STAGE 3 — EPISODES AND SHORT-FORM CONTENT



From each complete interview:



* Produce three focused YouTube episodes.

* Identify strong educational and attention-holding moments.

* Produce approximately 6–12 vertical Shorts/Reels.

* Add readable persistent titles, captions and branding.

* Format content correctly for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.

* Create promotional clips and commercials when assigned.

* Use OpusClip and human editorial judgment to select and refine clips.

* Ensure that automated clips are accurate, properly framed and understandable without additional context.



## STAGE 4 — THUMBNAILS AND VISUAL ASSETS



* Develop three distinct thumbnail concepts for each priority video.

* Select expressive, high-quality interview frames.

* Generate or edit supporting images when appropriate.

* Create readable thumbnail text that works on mobile.

* Avoid images that look artificial, distorted or obviously AI-generated.

* Follow Beauty Seek’s visual standards.

* Revise thumbnails based on feedback and YouTube click-through performance.

* Upload approved thumbnail assets into the correct production folders.



## STAGE 5 — YOUTUBE PACKAGING AND UPLOAD



* Upload completed videos to private YouTube for review.

* Upload the final approved versions.

* Add approved titles, descriptions and captions.

* Add chapters when required.

* Add end screens and cards.

* Connect Shorts and episodes to the correct complete interview.

* Add the appropriate recommended video.

* Verify thumbnails, links, tags, playlists and publishing settings.

* Check how every published asset appears on mobile.



## STAGE 6 — SOCIAL PUBLISHING



* Create and refine clips through OpusClip.

* Use OpusClip to schedule or publish approved videos to the designated social channels, including Instagram.

* Confirm that captions, covers, titles, tags and formatting transferred correctly.

* Confirm that every scheduled post appears on the correct account.

* Keep the production and publishing status updated.



## STAGE 7 — BEAUTY SLEEP AND EXTENDED VIDEO PRODUCTION



* Produce Beauty Sleep videos using rain, ocean, nature, fire and other approved sounds.

* Layer and balance multiple audio tracks so loops are natural and not repetitive.

* Create extended videos up to nine hours long.

* Create slow, calming visual sequences without obvious looping or abrupt changes.

* Produce and export the correct YouTube format.

* Create the accompanying thumbnail.

* Upload the completed video to YouTube.

* Verify the entire audio track for gaps, clipping, volume changes or failed loops.

* Have the equipment and technical knowledge to render nine-hour videos reliably.



## STAGE 8 — QUALITY CONTROL



Before anything is submitted, the editor must check:



* Audio clarity and consistency.

* Image quality, exposure and color.

* Spelling and grammar.

* Names and professional titles.

* Medical and technical terminology.

* Captions and on-screen text.

* Mobile readability.

* Correct aspect ratio and resolution.

* Logos, graphics and brand consistency.

* Smooth cuts and transitions.

* Thumbnail accuracy.

* YouTube links, end screens and recommended videos.

* Social handles and contact information.

* Final runtime and export integrity.



## REQUIRED PRODUCTION EXPERIENCE



### Source-footage correction



* Demonstrated experience correcting interview audio and video.

* Strong audio-cleanup skills.

* Strong color-correction and speaker-framing skills.

* Ability to work with separately recorded speaker tracks.



### Long-form production



* Demonstrated experience editing talking-head, interview or podcast-style YouTube videos.

* Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, hooks and viewer retention.

* Ability to manage videos exceeding 60 minutes.

* Ability to produce and reliably render videos lasting up to nine hours.



### Short-form production



* Experience converting long interviews into effective Shorts and Reels.

* Understanding of vertical framing, captions, mobile-safe text and opening hooks.

* Ability to distinguish a genuinely valuable clip from an automatically generated but contextless clip.



### Thumbnail production



* Experience designing YouTube thumbnails.

* Understanding of mobile readability and click-through behavior.

* Ability to use interview frames, typography and generated imagery without making the result look artificial.



### Publishing and channel management



* Experience with YouTube Studio.

* Experience uploading privately, publishing, adding thumbnails, captions, chapters, playlists, cards and end screens.

* Experience scheduling or publishing content to Instagram and other social channels.

* Experience with OpusClip or a comparable clipping and social-distribution platform.



## REQUIRED SOFTWARE AND AI CAPABILITIES



The candidate should have strong experience with most of the following:



* Adobe Premiere Pro.

* Adobe Media Encoder.

* Adobe Audition or comparable professional audio-cleanup software.

* Riverside.

* OpusClip.

* CapCut for selected short-form effects or filters.

* YouTube Studio.

* Google Drive and Google Sheets.

* ChatGPT or Claude for transcript review, clip identification and workflow support.

* Replicate or similar AI image and video-generation platforms.

* HeyGen or comparable AI-video tools.



AI must be used to improve speed and production—not to replace careful listening, visual inspection, editorial judgment or quality control.



## COMPUTER AND INTERNET REQUIREMENTS



Applicants must have:



* A professional editing computer capable of handling long-form HD footage.

* Sufficient RAM, storage and GPU performance for extended exports.

* The ability to render nine-hour videos without preventing all other work.

* Experience using Adobe Media Encoder or another background-rendering workflow.

* Fast, stable internet for downloading and uploading large source and finished files.

* Reliable local storage and backup practices.



Adobe Media Encoder allows long exports to run in the background while the editor continues working in Premiere.



Applicants must include their computer specifications, internet speed and the approximate time required to export a one-hour 1080p video.



## EXPECTED WEEKLY OUTPUT



Initial minimum:



* One complete long-form interview.

* Three focused YouTube episodes.

* Approximately 6–12 Shorts/Reels.

* Three thumbnail concepts per priority video.

* Related promotional clips and commercials.

* Complete YouTube packaging and uploads.



The production goal is to scale toward two complete interview packages per week while maintaining quality.



## PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Success in the first 90 days means:



* Deliverables arrive on the agreed schedule.

* Fewer than 10% of projects require more than one revision round.

* Basic audio, image, spelling or publishing errors are caught before submission.

* Long-form videos are rendered without unnecessary production delays.

* Thumbnails and opening sections improve based on performance data.

* Production status is updated consistently.

* The editor communicates early when a deadline or source-file problem is at risk.



Comparable OnlineJobs.ph postings commonly emphasize both long- and short-form production, thumbnail design, English proficiency, AI tools, retention, file organization and one-revision quality standards.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



1. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience.

2. Two examples of long-form interview or podcast editing.

3. Three examples of Shorts or Reels created from long-form footage.

4. Three YouTube thumbnail examples.

5. One example showing difficult audio you improved.

6. The editing and AI tools you use.

7. Your computer specifications.

8. Your internet upload and download speeds.

9. Your expected monthly salary in U.S. dollars.

10. Your availability for limited overlap with U.S. Central Time.



Begin your application with the words **BEAUTY VIDEO** so we know you read the complete posting.



Finalists will be invited to complete a paid editing test using the same source material and instructions.

The Role

This is a phone-heavy role — you'll be on the dialer most of your shift, following proven scripts (full training provided).

•  Follow up with warm leads on schedule

Schedule

•  Full-time, Monday–Friday

•  US Central Time business hours = overnight in the Philippines (approx. 10:00 PM–7:00 AM PHT)

•  You must be genuinely comfortable working the night shift long-term — please don't apply if this doesn't suit you



What We're Looking For

•  Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral accent (voice recording required with your application)

•  Previous cold calling, telemarketing, or BPO voice experience strongly preferred — US real estate experience is a big plus

•  Thick skin and a positive attitude — you handle rejection well and stay motivated

•  Coachable: you take feedback and improve quickly

•  Reliable setup: stable internet (25+ Mbps), backup power and backup internet, quality headset, quiet private workspace

•  Can follow a script while still sounding natural and conversational, not robotic

•  Honest and detail-oriented with CRM data entry



Compliance (Non-Negotiable)

•  Every number is scrubbed against the US Do-Not-Call registry before you dial — you will be trained on this process

•  You must follow calling-hour rules and honor every opt-out / do-not-call request exactly as trained

Compensation

•  $500–$700 USD/month starting, depending on experience — paid twice monthly via Wise

•  Performance bonuses for qualified appointments and closed deals

•  1-week paid trial, then monthly performance reviews with raises tied to results

•  This is a long-term role for the right person — we're building a team, not churning through callers



To Apply, Send All Four:

1.  Your resume/CV

2.  A 60–90 second voice recording: introduce yourself, then read this sample script naturally (like a real call, not reading): "Hi, this is ___ with Alamo Assignments. I'm trying to reach the homeowner of [street address] — are you the owner? Great — we're buying a couple of properties in your area, and I wanted to see if you'd consider a cash offer on your home. Is selling something you'd be open to?"

description:

## QUALITY EXPECTATIONS

- Repetitive designs

- Obvious AI-generated imagery

- Realistic imagery

- Clean composition

- Strong branding

- Creative concepts

- Scroll-stopping visuals

- Consistent quality across multiple brands

## AI + MANUAL DESIGN REQUIREMENT

- Adobe Firefly

- Midjourney

- Leonardo AI

- ChatGPT

- Runway

- Kling

- Other image/video generation tools



However, you must also know how to manually:



- Remove AI errors

- Correct unrealistic textures

- Fix hands, objects, products, backgrounds, and proportions

- Retouch photos

- Composite multiple images

- Color correct

- Remove or replace objects

- Adjust lighting

- Edit backgrounds

- Match branding

- Correct typography

- Blend AI elements naturally into real photography



We should never receive an obviously AI-generated image simply because an AI tool produced it.



## REQUIRED DESIGN SKILLS



Strong experience with:



- Adobe Photoshop

- Adobe Illustrator

- Canva Pro

- Figma or similar design software

- Photo manipulation and retouching

- Typography

- Layout and composition

- Brand design

- Social media graphic design

- Carousel design

- Advertising creative



## REQUIRED VIDEO SKILLS



Strong experience with:



- Adobe Premiere Pro and/or CapCut

- Short-form video editing

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok-style content

- Hooks and pacing

- Subtitles/captions

- Transitions

- Sound effects

- Music synchronization

- Motion graphics

- Basic color correction

- Text animation



After Effects experience is a strong advantage.



## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should:



- Have excellent visual judgment

- Understand current U.S. social media design trends

- Be able to switch between different brand styles

- Follow detailed creative briefs and SOPs

- Pay extremely close attention to instructions

- Work quickly without sacrificing quality

- Meet deadlines consistently

- Be organized when working across multiple client brands

- Communicate clearly

- Accept feedback professionally

- Apply previous feedback so the same corrections are not repeatedly needed

- Be comfortable working independently



Agency experience is strongly preferred.



Experience creating content for U.S., Canadian, UK, or Australian brands is a major plus.



## EXPERIENCE



We prefer **3+ years of professional graphic design and/or social media creative experience**.



However, portfolio quality matters more to us than years of experience.



If your work is exceptional, we want to see it.



## TO APPLY

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Head of Marketing — Hüga Collective



**Location:** Remote

**Type:** Full-time



Why We Exist



Hüga Collective was built on a simple belief: home should feel like a place you exhale in. We design hygge-inspired lighting — paper lamps, floor lamps, table lamps, and candle warmers — for people who want their space to feel warmer, slower, and more like *them*. We're not selling light fixtures. We're selling the feeling of coming home.



We're a small, fast-moving DTC brand, and we're looking for a Head of Marketing to become the strategic force behind everything we do next.



The Role



You'll be the marketing strategist and operator for the entire brand — the person who connects the dots between what we make, how we talk about it, and how we grow. You'll set direction, lead a small creative team, and get hands-on with the channels that drive our growth:
 and performance.



This is a builder's role. You'll have real ownership and a direct line to the founder.



### What You'll Own



- **Marketing strategy** — Set the roadmap across acquisition, retention, and brand, and make the calls on where we invest our time and budget.

- **Team leadership** — Oversee and direct our video editors and content designer, keeping creative output aligned with strategy and on brand.

- *
 marketing** — Strategize and create flows and campaign strategy (we run on Klaviyo), working alongside our designer contractor to keep the calendar sharp and revenue-driving.

- **Performance & growth content** — Lead ideation for ad creative and performance content, working closely with our creative team to turn insights into content that converts.

- **Influencer marketing** — Oversee our influencer strategy, from identifying the right partners to managing relationships and turning collaborations into content that performs.

- **Brand stewardship** — Make sure everything we put into the world sounds and feels like Hüga — warm, intentional, never generic.



## What You Bring



- **6+ years** in digital marketing, with real ownership of strategy — not just execution

- Proven experience marketing for an **ecommerce brand** (DTC strongly preferred)

- A track record of **managing or directing a creative team** (video editors, designers, contractors)

- Fluency in *
 marketing** — flows, segmentation, campaign strategy (Klaviyo experience a plus)

- A sharp eye for **performance/growth ad content** — you can ideate concepts that are built to convert, not just look nice

- Experience running or overseeing **influencer marketing**, from partner sourcing to relationship management

- **Fluent English**, written and spoken — you'll be shaping our voice

- You think like an owner. You see the whole board — brand, growth, team — and you know how to move all three forward at once.



## Why Hüga



- A brand with a clear point of view and room for you to shape where it goes next

- Direct access to leadership — your strategy becomes the strategy

- A small team that moves fast and cares deeply about the craft

- The chance to build the marketing function from a real leadership seat, not inherit someone else's playbook



---



*Hüga Collective is a home lighting brand built on the idea that comfort is a form of care. If that resonates with you — and you're ready to lead — we'd love to hear from you.*

title: Trading Instructor / Mentor
description:
Summary:

I am looking for an experienced Trading Instructor / Mentor who can provide structured, one-to-one training to help me develop strong knowledge and practical skills in the various markets (Forex, Crypto, Options and Futures).



The ideal instructor should have proven real-world trading experience as well as strong academic/theoretical knowledge of financial markets, technical analysis, fundamental analysis, risk management, and trading psychology.



What I Want to Learn:

- Market fundamentals and how the market works (Forex, Crypto, Options and Futures)

- Technical analysis and price action

- Fundamental and macroeconomic analysis

- Support / resistance and market structure

- Indicators and when/how to use them

- Trend-following and other trading strategies

- Entry, stop-loss and take-profit techniques

- Risk and money management

- Trading psychology and discipline

- Backtesting and strategy evaluation

- Various trading platforms and practical trade execution

- How to develop, test and improve a complete trading plan

- Understanding and evaluating EAs / algorithmic trading systems

- How to identify unrealistic profit claims and avoid high-risk trading practices



Instructor Requirements Must Have(s):

- At least 3–5 years of genuine trading experience

- Strong knowledge of financial markets

- Practical experience with MT4/MT5, TradingView, and similar trading platforms

- Good understanding of technical and fundamental analysis

- Strong knowledge of risk management

- Ability to explain complex concepts clearly to a beginner / intermediate learner

- Experience providing trading education or mentoring is preferred



IMPORTANT: I am looking for a teacher/mentor, not someone to manage my money or provide guaranteed-profit signals. I want to learn how to analyze the market and make informed trading decisions independently.



Training Format:

- One-to-one online sessions

- Part-Time role (1-2 hours Mon. / Wed. / Fri.; Weekends if needed) 

- Preferably through Zoom / Google Meet

- Structured lessons with practical examples

- Homework / practice exercises and feedback

- Demonstration using a demo trading account before live trading

- Training schedule can be mutually agreed

- Performance Incentives: Possibility of bonuses based on teaching effectiveness, progress achieved, and overall results

- Paid Trial Period: 1-2 sessions at a reduced introductory rate to confirm teaching style and fit before continuing long-term at regular rate.



How To Apply - Create a Video (Please Include):

- Your trading experience and number of years trading in Forex, Crypto, Options and Futures

- Your educational / academic background related to finance, economics, trading or markets

- Your teaching / mentoring experience

- Your preferred trading style and strategies

- Your experience with trading platforms, MT4 / MT5 and EAs

- Your availability and U.S. preferred time zone

- A brief outline of how you would structure the first 5–10 training sessions



Send Inquiries - 



Please do not apply if your main service is selling signals, EAs, managed accounts or promising guaranteed returns.



***I am looking for a serious, knowledgeable and patient instructor who can help me build long-term trading knowledge and disciplined trading skills in Forex, Crypto, Options and Futures.***

title: Senior Australian Tax Accountant / Reviewer & Team Leader
description:
We are an established Australian accounting, taxation and business advisory practice expanding our Philippines-based team.

We are seeking a highly capable Senior Australian Tax Accountant / Reviewer & Team Leader with strong Australian public-practice experience.

This is a hands-on senior role. You will be expected to prepare work personally when required, review work completed by accountants and bookkeepers, follow up clients and staff, improve processes and work closely with the Principal Accountant in Australia.

Key Responsibilities

- Prepare and review financial statements and Australian income tax returns for companies, trusts, partnerships and individuals across a broad range of business sectors.

- Apply strong practical knowledge of Australian tax, including CGT, Division 7A, trust distributions, GST/BAS/IAS, depreciation and director/shareholder loan accounts.

- Prepare and review general purpose and special purpose financial reports, with sound knowledge of applicable Australian Accounting Standards.

- Review bookkeeping, balance-sheet reconciliations, payroll, superannuation, GST accounts and supporting workpapers.

- Personally undertake bookkeeping and reconciliation work where required, including transactions from eBay, Amazon, Alibaba, Stripe, PayPal, Uber Eats, DoorDash and other e-commerce, merchant and payment platforms.

- Review work prepared by accountants and bookkeepers, identify errors, provide clear review notes and follow corrections through to completion.

- Delegate work appropriately, monitor progress and follow up staff located in Australia and overseas regarding deadlines, outstanding tasks and review points.

- Follow up clients for outstanding information and communicate professionally regarding accounting, taxation and reporting matters.

- Prepare and review monthly and quarterly management accounts, cash flow forecasts, budgets, rolling forecasts, actual-versus-budget reports and variance analysis for business clients.

- Analyse business performance, identify unusual movements and provide meaningful explanations of financial results, cash flow and key performance trends.

- Mentor and support accountants and bookkeepers and contribute to improvements in workpapers, workflows, reconciliations, review procedures and quality control.

- Use AI and modern accounting technology responsibly to improve efficiency, analysis, documentation and workflow while maintaining professional judgement and confidentiality.

- Work closely with the Principal Accountant on technical matters, complex files, client issues, workflow management and practice development.

- Assist with the future development of our Philippines operation, including team growth, onboarding, systems implementation and potential office establishment.

- Be willing to undertake occasional international business travel, including to Australia, where reasonably required for meetings, training, planning or other business purposes.

What We Are Looking For

- Minimum 5 years of verifiable Australian public-practice experience.

- Accounting or related degree; CPA or CA equivalent highly regarded.

- Strong hands-on Australian taxation knowledge.

- Experience preparing and reviewing company, trust, partnership and individual tax returns.

- Sound knowledge of AASB reporting requirements and financial statement preparation.

- Genuine experience reviewing accounting, bookkeeping and tax work prepared by other staff.

- Strong hands-on proficiency with Xero, Xero Tax, Xero Practice Manager (XPM) and MYOB.

- Advanced Excel skills and experience with management reporting, budgets, cash flow forecasting and variance analysis.

- Strong written and spoken English with confidence communicating directly with Australian clients.

- Ability to delegate, follow up staff and clients, manage deadlines and take ownership of work through to completion.

- Practical, hands-on attitude and willingness to step into bookkeeping, reconciliation, accounting or tax preparation where required.

Working Arrangement & Growth

The role will initially be remote and based in the Philippines.

As our Philippines operation grows, we may develop an office-based or hybrid team structure. The successful candidate may also take on broader leadership and operational responsibilities over time, with remuneration reviewed accordingly.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical Australian accounting and tax assessment before the final interview.

The assessment may include reviewing bookkeeping, reconciliations, financial statements, tax returns and workpapers, identifying accounting or tax issues, preparing review notes and explaining what should be corrected, queried with the client or escalated to the Principal Accountant.

The purpose of the assessment is to evaluate practical ability, technical knowledge, review skills, professional judgement and attention to detail.

Direct Applicants Only

We are recruiting directly and will consider individual applicants only. Agencies, outsourcing/staffing providers, subcontractors and third-party representatives should not apply.

Applicants must apply and participate in the recruitment process personally.

title: Short-Term Rental Operations, Bookkeeping & Personal Assistant
description:
Position: Long-Term

Hours: 20–40 hours per week

Compensation: $4 USD per hour

Schedule: Required availability between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM EST daily. Specific working hours will fall within this coverage window.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage the daily operations and bookkeeping of multiple U.S.-based Airbnb and short-term rental properties. The role will also include personal, administrative, purchasing, and travel-related responsibilities.

This role is ideal for someone who can take an unstructured request, research the situation, present good options, and follow the selected solution through to completion.

We do not want someone who only reports problems or waits for step-by-step instructions. We want someone who takes ownership, follows up without being reminded, verifies that work was actually completed, and knows when an issue needs to be escalated.

This is a long-term position with the potential for additional responsibility as our real estate portfolio grows.

Bookkeeping and Financial Administration

Bookkeeping will be a major part of this position. You will help keep the finances for each property and business entity accurate and organized.

Responsibilities include:

Manage bookkeeping using Intuit QuickBooks Online.

Review and classify bank and credit-card transactions regularly.

Ensure every transaction is assigned to the correct property, business entity, account, and expense category.

Separate expenses across multiple short-term rental properties and LLCs.

Reconcile bank accounts and credit-card accounts.

Match receipts and invoices to their corresponding transactions.

Track cleaner payments, contractor invoices, property supplies, repairs, utilities, subscriptions, and other operating expenses.

Identify duplicate, missing, unusual, or incorrectly categorized transactions.

Ask for clarification rather than guessing when the correct classification is uncertain.

Maintain organized digital copies of receipts, invoices, statements, and supporting documents.

Track reimbursements, refunds, credits, security deposits, and vendor payments.

Prepare monthly property-level income and expense summaries.

Help maintain accurate profit-and-loss reporting for each property.

Coordinate with our accountant or tax professional when information or documentation is requested.

Maintain a list of recurring payments and flag unexpected price increases or duplicate subscriptions.

Direct experience with QuickBooks Online and property-level bookkeeping is preferred.

Cleaning and Turnover Coordination

Monitor reservation and turnover calendars.

Schedule cleaners after guest checkouts.

Confirm that every turnover has an assigned cleaner.

Communicate early check-ins, late checkouts, guest counts, and special instructions to cleaners.

Confirm that cleaners arrived and completed each turnover on time.

Coordinate backup cleaners when someone becomes unavailable.

Follow up on cleaning problems until they are resolved.

Maintain cleaning checklists, schedules, invoices, and payment records.

Maintenance and Vendor Coordination

Coordinate lawn mowing, pool or hot-tub service, pest control, repairs, and other recurring property services.

Contact cleaners, contractors, handymen, technicians, and local vendors by phone, text, or
.

Obtain and compare estimates when appropriate.

Schedule approved work and coordinate property access.

Follow up until the work is actually completed.

Request photos, invoices, or other proof of completion.

Maintain records of maintenance issues, costs, warranties, and vendor contact information.

Identify reliable backup vendors before emergencies occur.

Guest and Reservation Support

Monitor Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, Hospitable, or related platforms as assigned.

Answer routine guest questions clearly and professionally.

Coordinate solutions for lockouts, missing supplies, cleanliness problems, amenity issues, and maintenance requests.

Escalate safety issues, refund requests, major repairs, unhappy guests, or unusual situations promptly.

Assist with reservation changes, guest reviews, and Airbnb support cases when needed.

Gather photos, messages, receipts, and other documentation for damage or reimbursement claims.

Property Administration

Track recurring services, permits, licenses, utilities, insurance, subscriptions, and renewal dates.

Monitor property supplies and coordinate approved restocking.

Keep listing information, amenities, house rules, and property guides accurate.

Organize property documents and operational records.

Create and improve SOPs and checklists for recurring tasks.

Provide a concise weekly report covering open issues, completed work, upcoming turnovers, expenses, and decisions needed.

Personal and Travel Assistance

The position will also include non-property tasks such as:

Research and compare flights based on total price, duration, stops, baggage rules, airports, and cancellation policies.

Research hotels, Airbnbs, transportation, restaurants, activities, and other travel details.

Create organized itineraries containing reservation details, addresses, confirmation numbers, travel times, and important deadlines.

Verify important details directly instead of relying only on search-result summaries or AI-generated information.

Book approved flights, accommodations, transportation, reservations, and activities.

Monitor travel plans for schedule changes, cancellations, or missing details.

Research products, services, vendors, subscriptions, and personal purchases.

Start, change, renew, or cancel subscriptions after receiving approval.

Place approved online orders and track deliveries, returns, credits, and refunds.

Make phone calls and follow up with companies on our behalf.

Organize calendars, reminders, documents, and recurring personal tasks.

Assist with basic video editing as needed, including trimming clips, adding captions and music, and formatting videos for social media. Prior video-editing experience is a plus, but is not required to be hired.

Purchasing and Financial Boundaries

You may eventually receive access to authorized accounts or controlled payment methods. Trust and discretion are essential.

Significant purchases must be approved before payment.

Never change payment, payout, banking, tax, or account-ownership information without explicit approval.

Never send money to yourself or an unapproved person or vendor.

Record purchases and save receipts immediately.

Confirm cancellation and refund policies before booking.

If instructions appear unusual or potentially fraudulent, stop and verify with us directly.

Never share passwords, financial information, guest information, or property access codes with unauthorized parties.

Required Qualifications

Excellent spoken and written English.

Experience as a Virtual Assistant, bookkeeper, property-management assistant, or operations coordinator.

Previous Airbnb or short-term rental experience is strongly preferred.

Comfortable calling U.S. businesses, cleaners, contractors, and customer-support departments.

Strong online research and comparison skills.

Able to manage multiple deadlines and follow up without reminders.

Able to distinguish between an urgent issue and one that can wait.

Comfortable handling confidential personal, guest, property, and financial information.

Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and preferably backup internet.

Comfortable using spreadsheets, task-management software, messaging applications, and AI tools.

AI may be used to work efficiently, but all important information must be independently verified.

Able to maintain availability during the required 8:00 AM–8:00 PM EST coverage window.

Helpful Experience

Experience with any of the following is beneficial:

Intuit QuickBooks Online // Bookkeeping for multiple properties or LLCs

Airbnb, VRBO, or Booking.com experience

Hospitable, Guesty, Hostaway, or another property-management system

PriceLabs or other dynamic-pricing software

Vendor dispatch, hospitality, customer service, or property maintenance

Basic video editing using CapCut, Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools (nice to have, not required).

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 30–60 days:

Transactions are consistently classified under the correct property, entity, and expense category.

Accounts and receipts remain organized and ready for monthly review.

Unknown transactions are flagged promptly instead of being guessed.

Every turnover is properly assigned and confirmed.

Cleaners and vendors receive the correct information without needing to chase us.

Maintenance problems are tracked through completion.

Upcoming renewals, services, and property needs do not surprise us.

Travel research is accurate, concise, and ready for a decision.

Approved bookings and purchases are completed correctly.

You identify potential problems early and bring us recommended solutions.

We spend significantly less time following up on routine financial, operational, and personal tasks.

How to Apply

Please include:

A short introduction.

Whether you have managed bookkeeping for multiple properties, businesses, or LLCs and your experience. 

Your relevant Airbnb or short-term rental experience along with any property-management tools you have used.

Your experience coordinating cleaners, contractors, or other field-service providers.

Confirmation that you can work 20–40 hours per week and maintain the required availability between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM EST.

A link to a 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and describing a scheduling, bookkeeping, or operational problem you solved.

The word “pineapple” in the subject line so we know you read the entire posting.

Please also answer the following scenario in no more than eight sentences:

A cleaner assigned to a same-day turnover says she cannot come. The current guest checks out at 11:00 AM, and the next guest checks in at 4:00 PM. Explain exactly what you would do.

Applications that do not answer the questions or include the requested word will not be considered.

title: Experienced Home Improvement Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
If you’re genuinely great at cold calling, we want to hear you make a cold call, not read a résumé.



We are a U.S. home remodeling company looking for an experienced appointment setter who knows how to turn a cold homeowner into a real conversation and a qualified appointment.



This is not a temporary campaign.  We’re looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our team and grow with the company.



THE JOB

You will call U.S. homeowners regarding projects including:



• Windows and doors

• Roofing

• Siding

• Decks and outdoor living

• Other residential remodeling projects



You are not closing sales.



Your job is to:



Start the conversation → uncover a real project → create interest → handle objections → qualify the homeowner → schedule the appointment.



WE CARE ABOUT QUALITY, NOT JUST BOOKINGS

We measure:



Dials → Conversations → Qualified Appointments → Appointments Held



Putting someone on the calendar who isn’t genuinely interested is not a successful appointment.



We want callers who know how to create enough genuine interest that the homeowner understands the reason for the appointment and actually wants to meet with us.



WHO WE WANT

We’re looking for someone who:



• Has proven outbound cold-calling experience

• Speaks clear, fluent, easy-to-understand English

• Sounds natural and conversational, not scripted

• Is comfortable calling U.S. homeowners

• Can confidently handle objections such as “not interested,” “I’m busy,” and “send me information”

• Knows how to ask questions and uncover a real home improvement need

• Can consistently work U.S. Eastern Time hours

• Is competitive, coachable and accountable for results



Experience in home improvement, roofing, windows, siding, HVAC, solar, real estate, insurance or other high-ticket consumer calling is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION

$5–$8/hour depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person.  Strong performance can lead to increased compensation and additional responsibility.



WE PROVIDE

• Calling lists

• Dialer/CRM

• Proven scripts and talking points

• Home improvement training

• Qualification standards

• Appointment-setting process

• Coaching and call review

• Consistent leads



You focus on calling, conversations and appointments.  Our sales team handles the in-home consultation and sale.



HOW TO APPLY

Do not send us a generic cover letter.



We want to hear whether you can actually cold call.



1. Send a 60–90 second voice recording.



Pretend a homeowner answers:



“Hello?”



Make the call.



Show us how you would open the conversation, get their attention, identify whether they have a home improvement project and move toward an appointment.



During the recording, have the homeowner tell you:



“No thanks. We’re not interested in doing anything right now.”



Then handle the objection exactly as you would on a real call.



2. Send your actual numbers from your most recent relevant campaign:



Dials per day:

Conversations per day:

Appointments booked per day/week:

Appointment show rate:

Industry/campaign:



If you don’t know a number, say you don’t know.  Do not estimate.



3. Answer these questions:



What country and time zone are you in?



How many years have you cold called?



Have you called U.S. homeowners before?  What were you offering?



What CRM and dialers have you used?



What hours can you consistently work Eastern Time?



HIRING PROCESS

Strong applicants will be invited to a short video interview with live cold-call and objection-handling roleplays.



The best candidates will then complete a paid trial using real leads.



We’re looking for someone who can hear:



“I’m not interested.”



…and turn it into a real conversation about a project the homeowner has actually been considering.



If that’s you, we want to hear you do it.

title: Video Editor & Motion Designer
description:
Role summary: Owns everything from rough cut to final assembly — cutting narration-driven long-form video, building 2D motion graphics and text animations, and handling music/sound design — for Paper Trail's fraud & scandal documentaries.



Paper Trail is a new narrated documentary channel covering financial fraud and corporate scandal (Ponzi schemes, accounting fraud, cover-ups, market manipulation), in the Hoog / Fern / Jake Tran mold.

- Work directly from the script's flagged visual cues and the shot list.

- Take a cut through multiple review rounds, incorporating notes until it's locked for publish.

- Help build reusable templates (title card, lower-third, text-animation presets) as the channel's asset library matures.



What we're looking for:

- A sound design instinct — using music and SFX to build tension rather than leaning on stock drop-ins.

- Comfortable respecting the channel's visual identity consistently (from an animation to the next, from one video to the next).

- Always eager to improve and learn.



Software knowledge we're looking for:

- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Adobe After Effects

- Frame.io

- Notion

title: Amazon OA Sourcing VA | 3P Mercury Experience a Plus
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) Sourcing VA to help us find high-quality ASINs and build our sourcing database, which we call our Lead Vault.



This is a focused sourcing role. You will not be responsible for purchase orders, inventory management, logistics, or other day-to-day operations. Your primary responsibility will be finding, evaluating, validating, and documenting profitable sourcing opportunities.



About Us:

We operate a growing Amazon Online Arbitrage business and are expanding our sourcing team. We use Keepa, ArbiSource, Replen Scout, and 3P Mercury to identify opportunities, evaluate ASINs, and maintain our Lead Vault.



Experience with 3P Mercury is helpful but not required. If you have strong Amazon OA sourcing skills, we can train you on our system and workflow.



Key Responsibilities

- Find promising ASINs through manual sourcing, reverse sourcing, product research, and other proven OA methods.

- Evaluate each ASIN’s sales history, estimated velocity, profitability, competition, pricing stability, and sourcing potential.

- Use Keepa confidently, including chart analysis, Product Finder, offer history, and seller data.

- Validate exact product matches by checking UPCs or model numbers, variations, pack sizes, quantities, colors, sizes, and included items.

- Review potential suppliers for legitimacy, product condition, availability, shipping costs, and return policies.

- Add qualified ASINs and accurate sourcing information to our Lead Vault in 3P Mercury.

- Maintain clean, complete, and reliable sourcing records.

- Report weekly and monthly results, including database growth, qualified leads added, and relevant sourcing trends.



What We’re Looking For:

Required Qualifications

- Hands-on experience with Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing.

- A practical understanding of profitability calculations, Amazon fees, ROI, sales rank, Buy Box behavior, offer counts, and FBA competition.

- A proven ability to find and evaluate ASINs using one or more sourcing methods.

- Strong Keepa skills, including the ability to interpret charts and recognize unstable pricing, seasonal demand, Amazon presence, and changes in competition.

- Excellent attention to detail when confirming product matches, variations, pack sizes, supplier information, and sourcing data.

- Good judgment and the ability to reject leads that do not meet established criteria.

- Coachability and a willingness to learn our sourcing standards and Lead Vault system.

- Clear written communication, dependable availability, reliable internet, and a quiet workspace.



Computer and Internet Requirements:

Because 3P Mercury is used alongside Keepa, retailer websites, spreadsheets, and multiple browser tabs, applicants must have a computer that can handle this workflow smoothly.

- Processor: Intel Core i5, AMD Ryzen 5, Apple M1, or a comparable or newer processor

- Memory: At least 16 GB RAM recommended for running 3P Mercury and multiple research tabs without significant slowdown

- Storage: SSD with at least 20 GB of available space

- Operating system:A currently supported version of Windows or macOS with security updates enabled

- Browser: The latest version of Google Chrome, with permission to install any extensions required for the role

- Display: At least a 1920 × 1080 screen

- Internet: Stable connection with at least 25 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload speed

- Backup: A dependable backup internet option is strongly preferred



A Chromebook, tablet, or mobile phone alone is not suitable for this position. Applicants may be asked to submit a screenshot of their computer specifications and an internet speed test during the screening process.





Attention check: Begin the subject line or heading of your application with 3PM so we know you read the full posting.



Preferred but Not Required

- Experience using 3P Mercury, ArbiSource and/or Replen Scout

- Experience using cashback platforms such as Rakuten, BeFrugal, or TopCashback.

- Familiarity with discounted gift cards and other legitimate cost-saving methods.



Screening Questions:



Please answer all five questions in your application. We are looking for practical knowledge and clear explanations; generic or AI-style answers without specific examples will not be considered.

1.)Walk us through your sourcing process. What tools and methods do you use? Approximately how many ASINs can you find and fully validate in a typical week? What criteria must a lead meet before you consider it qualified?

2.) How do you evaluate an ASIN’s profitability and risk? Which metrics do you review, and which ones carry the most weight in your decision? Please explain why.

3.)Have you used 3P Mercury? If yes, explain how its sourcing and Lead Vault approach differs from a traditional OA workflow and why that difference matters. If you have not used it, simply write: Never used 3PM.

4.) What is your biggest sourcing challenge? Where do you typically lose the most time, and how do you try to solve that problem?

5.)Why are you interested in this position? What appeals to you about specializing in sourcing and database building rather than handling purchasing or operations?



Position Details:

Type: Part-time

Schedule: Approximately 15–20 hours per week, with flexibility based on availability and performance

Rate: Competitive and based on experience; please include your desired hourly rate

Location: Remote; Philippines-based applicants are preferred

Start Date: Flexible—we would rather find the right person than rush the hiring process

Tools Provided: Access to 3P Mercury, Keepa, ArbiSource, and other approved tools required for the role



How to Apply:

Please include the following:

- Answers to all five screening questions.

- A summary of your Amazon OA experience, including how many years you have worked in sourcing, the types of businesses you have supported, and the tools you have used.

- Details about your 3P Mercury experience, if applicable, including how long you have used it, the features you use most, and the largest Lead Vault you have helped manage. If you have never used 3P Mercury, say so—this will not automatically disqualify you.

- Your desired hourly rate.

- Your weekly availability and preferred working hours.

- A brief example of a successful lead you found and the reasoning you used to qualify it. Please do not share confidential information from a previous client.



Please use four or more Apply Points when submitting through OnlineJobs.ph. This helps us identify applicants who are genuinely interested in this specific role rather than applying to positions in bulk.



We value strong sourcing fundamentals, accuracy, good judgment, coachability, and consistent performance. If you already know 3P Mercury, you may be able to get started quickly. If you do not, but you are an experienced and careful OA sourcer, we are happy to train you on our system.

title: German-Speaking Video Editor (Mid–Senior) | Long-Term, Starting Part-Time
description:
German-Speaking Video Editor (Mid–Senior) | Long-Term Role

Künstlerkartell | Magdeburg, Germany (Remote / Offshore)



Künstlerkartell is a video and content agency from Magdeburg, Germany. We make social media content, recruiting and employer branding videos, image films and a business podcast ("Der MACHER Podcast") for owner-led companies in construction, trades, industry and technical services.



Our style is real people and real moments. No glossy staging. We believe good content only works with a strategy behind it, so every video we make has a clear goal before anyone presses record. Our clients are proud of what they do, and we want the videos to show that.



I'm building a team, and I'm looking for an experienced video editor who speaks German to join us long-term and take editing work off my desk.



THE ROLE



At the start, the focus is on short-form content:



- Reels and short videos for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and YouTube Shorts

- Recruiting and employer branding clips (real employees talking about their work)

- Cutdowns from interviews, image films and podcast episodes



As you settle in, you'll also:



- Edit longer pieces like image films and podcast episodes

- Take ownership of complete edits from rough cut to final version

- Take on more projects and responsibility as we grow together



You'll get raw footage (mostly interviews and on-site shoots in German), a clear brief and the goal of the video. Then we trust you to find the story, send versions, take feedback and refine.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



A mid–senior editor who:



- Speaks and understands German well. Most of our footage is German interviews, so you need to follow what people say, pick the strongest lines and check German subtitles. Minimum level B2, C1 or native is a big plus.

- Knows how to tell a story, not just cut clips

- Has a feel for social media: hooks, pacing, subtitles, formats

- Works efficiently without sacrificing quality

- Takes ownership and pride in their work

- Communicates clearly and says early when something is unclear

- Is curious about AI tools and new workflows. Especially now, we keep asking how we can make our work better and faster, and we want you to bring ideas.



This is not a junior role. You should be comfortable making creative decisions and making the footage better than what the brief asked for.



TOOLS & WORKFLOW



Required:



- Strong experience in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- Experience with subtitles and captions for social media



Nice to have:



- After Effects, motion graphics or simple animation

- Color grading

- Sound design or audio cleanup



How we work:



- We have our own project management tool for tasks, reviews and feedback

- Everything else runs on Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Meet)

- Short check-in when needed, otherwise we communicate in writing during the day



LOCATION & AVAILABILITY



- We're based in Germany (CET). Your afternoon is our morning, so there is plenty of overlap.

- Deadlines are set clearly per project. No constant fire drills.



START & GROWTH



I want to start slowly and do this properly:



- We begin with a paid trial edit, then part-time at around 20 hours per week for $500/month

- If it works for both of us, pay goes up with hours and results

- The goal is a long-term role, ideally full-time later on



CULTURE



We are a small team that is growing. Honest, direct, no drama. We care about good work, clear boundaries and having fun doing it. Family and health come first, for us and for you.



You'll fit in well if you:



- Enjoy working with real people instead of actors

- Give honest feedback and can take it

- Want to grow with a small company over years, not months



IMPORTANT APPLICATION NOTE



To show that you've read this job description and that you speak German, start your application with two or three sentences in German about why you want this job. Somewhere in those sentences, include the phrase:



"echt statt perfekt"



Applications without the German sentences and this phrase will not be considered.

title: SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR (RETENTION-FOCUSED)
description:
SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR (RETENTION-FOCUSED)

Health & Wellness Brand | Part-Time → Long-Term | Remote



ABOUT US

We're a US health and wellness brand building one of the biggest short-form accounts in hormones, weight loss, and longevity. Our founder films 10+ talking-head reels a week. We need an editor who makes them impossible to scroll past, not just someone who cuts them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Edit about 10 talking-head reels per week (30–60 seconds) from raw footage and a short brief

- Restructure when needed: move the strongest line to the start, cut dead air hard, reorder the talk if it flows better

- Build retention: a visual change every 2–3 seconds (zooms, B-roll, graphics), an on-screen text hook, and clean designed captions

- Cut 4 hook variants per week: new openings on our past reels, and tell us which ones you'd try

- Send 1–2 honest notes with every batch (for example "take 2 was stronger, here's why" or "this story is too long for 40 seconds")

- Review our weekly performance numbers from our analyst and adjust your edits based on what's working

- Deliver on time, with subtitle files (.srt) and clean file naming in Google Drive



TURNAROUND

Within 48 hours of receiving footage.



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years editing short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

- Premiere Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

- Portfolio with view counts or retention results

- English strong enough to follow spoken content and give clear notes

- Bonus: talking-head, podcast-clip, or health/fitness content experience



IMPORTANT

We're a health brand, so all on-screen text and captions are approved by us before posting. Never add claims, stats, or text that isn't in the brief.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Write "RETENTION" as the first word of your application.

2. Send 3 short-form videos you edited, with their views or retention.

3. Pick one of them and tell us what you changed and why.

4. Watch this reel of ours: [link]. Tell us the first thing you'd fix.

Applications without all four will not be reviewed.

title: CEO personal assistant — $4-8+ DOE — Full-Time, Phone Based — Must Work Central Time — Video In
description:
WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR SOMEONE TO TAKE TASKS OFF MY PLATE. WE ARE HIRING SOMEONE TO KEEP ME ON MY OWN STANDARD, EVERY HOUR OF THE DAY.



If you're picturing a normal VA job where you get a task list and go do it on your own, this isn't that. This role is on a live call with me, essentially the whole day, every day. Your job isn't to do my work. Your job is to make sure I'm never wasting time, never drifting off my checklist, and always operating at my own standard, in real time, not after the fact.



30A Window Washing is a growing home services company in Florida. I'm the owner, and I am the biggest constraint in this business right now, not because I don't know what to do, but because nobody is holding my floor the way I hold everyone else's. I need someone permanently on my hip, on the phone, whose entire job is making sure I stay productive and on standard all day long.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN:



Stay on a live call with me through the day, tracking what I'm actually doing against my daily checklist as it happens, not reviewing it after the fact

Call it out the moment I drift off task, get pulled into something low value, or start stalling, and redirect me immediately, don't wait for me to notice it myself

Hold my personal floor and standard the same way I expect it held for my team, meaning you don't let it slide just because I'm the owner

Learn my specific dialect, phrasing, and the way I actually think, well enough to follow me even when I explain something fast or badly

Keep a real record of where my time actually went during the day, so we're working off data, not a guess, on where it leaks

Flag patterns that repeat across days, not just single moments, so we fix the root habit instead of one instance of it



THIS IS NOT A TASK BASED VA JOB. HERE'S WHAT'S REQUIRED:



An iPhone and a genuinely reliable internet connection. This role does not work if the call keeps dropping

8/10 English or higher, spoken. You are talking with me almost the entire day, this is not a writing job

Real availability for a sustained, essentially full workday of live phone time. This isn't something you do between other things

Thick skin and no need to be agreed with. Part of the job is telling me when I'm off my own standard, and I won't always like hearing it in the moment. That's the point, not a bug

Sharp listening and fast pattern recognition. You are not managing a task list, you are managing my attention in real time

**6 days a week required



WHAT WE OFFER:



$3-5/hr DOE to start, paid [weekly/bi-weekly] (a lot of room for growth)

More direct, constant access to me than almost anyone else on the team gets

Real path to grow into a broader right hand or executive assistant role once you've proven you can actually hold this one



HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY. Applications that don't follow these exact instructions will not be considered. If you can't follow instructions in a job post, you can't hold my floor either.



Your application subject/first line must read exactly:



SHADOW — [Your Name] — [Your English Self-Rating 1-10]



Answer these 3 questions in your application:

Describe a real time you had to keep someone else accountable in the moment, not through a task list or a message later. What did you actually say to them?

If I'm mid sentence explaining something and you don't fully understand what I mean, what do you do, right then, on the call?

This job pays $3/hr for close to a full day of live phone time. Tell me honestly why that works for you, and how long you actually see yourself doing this.

Record a 60-90 second video (Loom or your phone camera) introducing yourself IN ENGLISH, telling me why you're the right fit.



NO VIDEO = NO CONSIDERATION, regardless of how strong your application reads.



If you've read this far and you're still interested, start your application with the word "FLOOR" so I know you actually read the whole post.

title: ServiceTitan + QuickBooks Revenue Recovery Specialist | Warranty Claims & Accounts Receivable
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based electrical, generator, and home-service company looking for an experienced ServiceTitan + QuickBooks Specialist to help manage warranty claims, customer accounts receivable, and financial reconciliation.



This position is ideal for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working with numbers, and takes ownership of outstanding items through resolution.



Hands-on experience with both ServiceTitan and QuickBooks Online is strongly preferred. Experience working with a U.S.-based home-service company is a major plus.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Warranty Claims & Recovery



* Prepare and submit manufacturer warranty claims

* Verify required documentation before submission

* Track claims from submission through payment

* Follow up on unpaid, delayed, or rejected claims

* Correct and resubmit rejected claims

* Track warranty parts, labor reimbursements, credits, and payments

* Communicate with manufacturers and vendors to resolve claim issues

* Maintain accurate claim records and follow-up dates

* Ensure outstanding warranty claims continue moving toward resolution



Customer Accounts Receivable



* Monitor customer balances and A/R aging

* Follow up with customers regarding outstanding invoices

* Send invoices, statements, payment links, and reminders

* Track payment commitments and follow-up dates

* Investigate billing discrepancies and disputed invoices

* Ensure customer payments are properly applied

* Identify completed jobs that still have outstanding balances

* Help maintain low and healthy accounts receivable



ServiceTitan + QuickBooks



* Review invoices, payments, credits, refunds, and customer balances

* Understand how financial information flows between ServiceTitan and QuickBooks Online

* Identify and investigate discrepancies between the two systems

* Assist with payment, deposit, and account reconciliation

* Monitor unapplied payments and credits

* Help maintain clean and accurate financial records

* Assist with A/R, warranty recovery, and cash-flow reporting



What We’re Looking For



Our ideal candidate has:



* Strong hands-on ServiceTitan experience

* Strong hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

* Accounts receivable and reconciliation experience

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organization and follow-through

* Good written and spoken English

* Comfort working with numbers and financial records

* Ability to investigate discrepancies and solve problems independently

* A strong sense of ownership and accountability



Experience with warranty claims, manufacturer reimbursements, bookkeeping, collections, or U.S. HVAC, plumbing, electrical, generator, or other home-service companies is highly preferred.



The Right Person for This Role



We’re looking for someone who doesn’t simply record an outstanding item and move on.



If a warranty claim hasn’t been paid, a customer has an outstanding balance, or ServiceTitan and QuickBooks don’t match, we want someone who will investigate the issue, determine the next action, follow up, and continue working it until it is resolved.



Our goal is to find someone who can become a trusted part of our team and take real ownership of this area of the business.



To Apply



Please send us your résumé along with a brief introduction describing your experience with ServiceTitan and QuickBooks Online.



Experience with accounts receivable, warranty claims, bookkeeping, reconciliation, or U.S. home-service companies is a major plus.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (Fitness Education Channel)
description:
# Long-Form YouTube Video Editor — Fitness Education Channel



**Type:** Part-Time / Freelance

**Starting Volume:** 1 YouTube video per week

**Typical Video Length:** 8–12 minutes

**Starting Pay:** $30–$40 USD per completed video

**Potential:** Long-term recurring work with increased pay and volume



## About The Role



I run an online fitness coaching and education brand focused on helping men get leaner, get below 15% body fat, build structure, become more consistent, and understand how to actually manage their fitness long term.



I'm looking for a reliable long-form YouTube editor who can take my recorded footage and turn it into a clean, professional, educational YouTube video.



This is primarily a **post-production role**.



I will handle:



* Video topics

* Research

* Scripts

* Talking points

* Recording

* Overall content strategy

* Offers and CTAs



Your job is to take the raw footage and script and turn them into a polished YouTube video that is ready to publish.



---



# The Content



Most videos will be educational fitness videos between approximately **8–12 minutes**.



Topics may include:



* How to get below 15% body fat

* How to reach 10–12% body fat

* How to lose fat without losing muscle

* Calories and macros

* Protein

* Foods for fat loss

* Training

* Cardio

* Fitness mistakes

* Why people regain weight

* Why men struggle with consistency

* Building discipline

* Creating structure

* Habit change

* Mindset

* Fitness case studies

* Client examples

* Breaking down common fitness myths



The videos will normally be scripted or highly structured.



You will receive the script along with the footage.



---



# Editing Style



I am NOT looking for extremely flashy or over-edited YouTube videos.



The priority is:



**Clear education + strong pacing + visual support + viewer retention.**



The editing should make the information easier to understand without distracting from the speaker.



Think:



**Professional fitness education rather than entertainment editing.**



Most videos will primarily be talking-head footage.



Your edits may include:



* Removing mistakes

* Removing dead space

* Removing unnecessary pauses

* Tightening pacing

* Cleaning audio

* Basic color correction

* Jump cuts

* Strategic punch-ins and zooms

* On-screen text

* Key-word highlighting

* B-roll

* Images

* Screenshots

* Fitness footage

* Food images

* Simple diagrams

* Simple charts

* Study screenshots

* Before-and-after examples when provided

* Basic animations

* Light sound effects

* Light background music when appropriate



You should understand that **more editing does not automatically mean better editing.**



The information is the product.



Your editing should help the viewer understand and stay engaged with that information.



---



# Example



If the video is:



**“How I Would Go From 20% Body Fat to 12% Body Fat”**



I may provide you with:



* The complete script

* Talking-head footage

* Supporting screenshots

* Studies or graphs

* Before-and-after images

* Specific visual examples



Your job would be to:



1. Tighten the talking-head footage.

2. Remove mistakes and unnecessary pauses.

3. Maintain strong pacing.

4. Add text when an important concept needs emphasis.

5. Insert relevant B-roll or images where appropriate.

6. Display graphs, examples, or screenshots when they're mentioned.

7. Use simple visual changes to prevent the video from becoming visually stagnant.

8. Clean the audio and color.

9. Deliver a finished 16:9 YouTube video ready to publish.



The video should feel professional without feeling overly produced.



---



# Purpose Of The Content



These videos will primarily be used as **educational middle-of-funnel content**.



The goal is not just to get random views.



The goal is to build:



**Attention → Education → Trust → Proof → Interest in coaching**



Someone should be able to watch one of these videos and think:



**“This guy clearly understands how to solve the problem I'm dealing with.”**



You are not responsible for creating the marketing strategy.



However, understanding the purpose of the content will help you make smarter editing decisions.



---



# Starting Workload



We will start with:



**1 long-form YouTube video per week.**



Approximately:



**4 videos per month.**



Typical finished runtime:



**8–12 minutes.**



If everything goes well, the amount of work may increase over time.



There may also eventually be opportunities to work on:



* Additional weekly YouTube videos

* Short-form content

* Video sales letters

* Client case studies

* Fitness educational series

* Other content for the brand



I'm looking for someone who wants **consistent long-term work**, not someone looking for one or two random projects.



---



# Compensation



Starting compensation will be approximately:



**$30–$40 USD per finished video.**



The final rate will depend on:



* Quality

* Experience

* Editing ability

* Turnaround time

* Communication

* Ability to follow the reference style



Videos requiring substantially more graphics, animations, or editing may be compensated differently when agreed upon beforehand.



This role will begin with a **paid test project**.



If you consistently deliver strong work and become easier to work with over time, compensation and workload can increase.



---



# What I'm Looking For



You should have experience editing long-form YouTube videos.



You should understand:



* Talking-head editing

* Educational content

* YouTube pacing

* Retention

* Story flow

* B-roll placement

* Text overlays

* Basic motion graphics

* Audio cleanup

* Color correction

* Visual storytelling



Most importantly, you should understand **when NOT to edit**.



I do not want random effects every three seconds.



The editing needs to support the information.



---



# Software



You may use:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut Desktop



I care more about the final product than which software you use.



---



# Turnaround Time



Target turnaround:



**2–4 days after receiving the footage.**



Communication matters.



If something is going to be late, communicate before the deadline.



I do not want to constantly follow up asking when a video will be completed.



---



# Long-Term Opportunity



I'm deliberately starting this relationship small.



The first goal is simple:



**Prove that we work well together.**



If you consistently:



* Produce good work

* Follow instructions

* Meet deadlines

* Communicate clearly

* Learn the editing style

* Reduce the number of revisions

* Become easier to work with over time



then I want to continue increasing your responsibilities, workload, and compensation as the brand grows.



I'm looking for someone who could potentially become my **long-term YouTube editor**.



---



# Paid Test



Shortlisted applicants will receive a **paid test edit**.



You will receive:



* Raw footage

* Script

* Editing instructions

* Reference material



The test will evaluate:



* Pacing

* Editing judgment

* Visual choices

* Ability to follow instructions

* Communication

* Turnaround time

* Attention to detail



I do not expect free work.



---



# How To Apply



Please send:



1. Your name

2. Your location

3. Your primary editing software

4. How long you have been editing YouTube videos

5. Links to your **3 best long-form YouTube edits**

6. Examples of talking-head or educational videos you've edited

7. Your normal turnaround time for an 8–12 minute video

8. How many long-form videos you could realistically edit per week

9. Whether you're comfortable starting at $30–$40 per video

10. Why you're interested in building a long-term working relationship



Please do NOT send me only TikTok or Instagram examples.



I specifically want to see **long-form YouTube work**.



Finally, answer this question:



**How would you make a 10-minute talking-head educational video engaging without over-editing it?**



At the very beginning of your application, write:



**LONGFORM**



Applications without **LONGFORM** at the top will not be considered.
