description:
Business Development & Lead Generation VA – Remote Commercial Cleaning Company





Redo of the last application to many was unqualified. Please don’t not apply if you don’t have experience we are looking for someone who already has experience! 







Company: ProClean365

Industry: Commercial Cleaning / Facility Services

Location: Remote

Work Arrangement: Full-time

Pay: $4–$7 USD/hour depending on experience

Schedule: Monday–Friday, U.S. Eastern Time

Potential for: Performance bonuses and increased pay based on results



About Us



ProClean365 is a growing commercial cleaning company serving businesses in North Carolina.



We provide recurring commercial cleaning and facility services for offices, medical facilities, restaurants, churches, property management companies, retail locations, warehouses, and other commercial properties.



We are looking for a highly motivated Business Development & Lead Generation VA from the Philippines who can help us consistently find new commercial cleaning opportunities.



This is NOT a basic data-entry VA position.



We want someone who can research, think, communicate professionally, find opportunities, and help turn prospects into real business.



Your Main Mission



Your job is simple:



Find businesses that need commercial cleaning → identify the right decision-maker → start the conversation → qualify the opportunity → follow up → book the opportunity for the owner.



You will NOT be responsible for physically cleaning properties.



You will work directly with the business owner and become an important part of our growth team.



Responsibilities



1. Find Commercial Cleaning Opportunities



Research businesses and organizations that may need cleaning services, including:



* Medical offices

* Dental offices

* Urgent care centers

* Clinics

* Restaurants

* Office buildings

* Warehouses

* Churches

* Schools

* Daycares

* Apartment communities

* Property management companies

* Retail stores

* Auto dealerships

* Gyms

* Industrial facilities

* Government facilities

* Construction companies

* Real estate companies

* Commercial property owners



You will also research companies that are actively looking for cleaning vendors.



2. Find the Decision-Maker



You will identify people such as:



* Facility Managers

* Property Managers

* Operations Managers

* Office Managers

* General Managers

* Procurement Managers

* Business Owners

* Directors of Operations

* Facilities Directors



You will research their contact information and organize it in our CRM.



3. Lead Generation



You will build qualified prospect lists containing:



* Company name

* Website

* Location

* Contact name

* Job title

*

* Phone number when available

* Type of facility

* Estimated opportunity

* Source of the lead

* Notes

* Follow-up status



4. Outreach



Depending on the opportunity, you may use:



*

* Website contact forms

* LinkedIn

* Business directories

* RFP/bid platforms

* Vendor registration portals

* Other legitimate online channels



You will use company-approved scripts and messaging.



We want targeted outreach to businesses that have a legitimate potential need for commercial cleaning.



5. Follow-Up



Follow-up is extremely important.



You will maintain organized follow-up sequences and make sure prospects don’t get forgotten.



For example:



Day 1: Initial contact

Day 3: Follow-up

Day 7: Follow-up

Day 14: Follow-up

Day 30: Long-term follow-up



You will document every interaction in the CRM.



6. Qualify Opportunities



When someone responds, you will gather basic information such as:



* What type of facility is it?

* Where is it located?

* Approximate square footage, if known

* How often do they need cleaning?

* What areas need to be cleaned?

* Are they currently using another cleaning company?

* When are they looking to start?

* Do they need recurring service?

* Who makes the final decision?

* Do they need a walkthrough or proposal?



You will then pass qualified opportunities to the owner.



7. Appointment Setting



Your goal is to schedule qualified opportunities directly onto the owner’s calendar.



You should be comfortable communicating professionally with business owners and managers.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is:



* Excellent in written English

* Comfortable communicating with U.S. businesses

* Organized

* Detail-oriented

* Self-motivated

* Persistent

* Good at online research

* Comfortable learning new software

* Able to follow SOPs

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable using spreadsheets and CRM systems

* Interested in business development and sales



Experience That Is a Plus



Experience with any of the following is helpful:



* Commercial cleaning

* Lead generation

* B2B sales

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Cold

* LinkedIn prospecting

* CRM management

* HubSpot

* Google Maps research

* Google Sheets

* RFP research

* Vendor registration

* Property management

* Facility management

* Construction

* Janitorial services



Experience is preferred, but proven ability and attitude are more important than having a perfect resume.



Important: This Is a Results-Based Position



We are not looking for someone who simply completes a list of tasks.



We want someone who thinks:



“How can I find this company a new commercial cleaning opportunity today?”



You will be given training, tools, scripts, and SOPs.



But we also want you to bring ideas to the table.



If you discover a new website, database, industry, prospecting method, or source of commercial cleaning opportunities, we want you to tell us.



Performance Expectations



During the first few weeks, we will focus on learning our system and building a consistent pipeline.



Once trained, your responsibilities will include measurable targets such as:



* Qualified prospects researched/ Find Leads

* Decision-makers identified

* Outreach completed

* Follow-ups completed

* Conversations started

* Qualified opportunities generated

* Appointments booked

* Proposals/opportunities created



Quality matters more than simply sending hundreds of messages.



Tools



You may work with:



* HubSpot CRM

* Google Sheets

* Gmail

* Google Maps

* LinkedIn

* Online directories

* RFP/bid websites

* Company websites

* Other tools we provide



You should be comfortable learning new software.



Compensation



Starting pay:



$4–$7 USD/hour



depending on experience and demonstrated ability. We don’t want someone that willingly to learn we want someone that’s already done this before. That knows what they are DOING!



Additional performance incentives may be available for qualified opportunities and closed recurring commercial accounts.



There is also an opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation as the company grows.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions.



1. Tell us about your previous experience with lead generation or business development.



2. Have you worked with U.S. businesses before? If yes, explain.



3. Have you worked in commercial cleaning, janitorial services, property management, facilities, construction, or another B2B industry?



4. What methods would you use to find commercial cleaning customers in North Carolina?



5. Give me 5 types of businesses you would target first and explain why.



6. If I gave you the name of a commercial building, explain exactly how you would find the person responsible for hiring the cleaning company.



7. What CRM systems have you used?



8. What lead-generation tools or websites have you used?



9. How do you normally organize your follow-ups so leads don’t get lost?



10. Write a short professional
 you would send to a property manager introducing ProClean365’s commercial cleaning services.



11. How many hours per week are you available?



12. What is your preferred working schedule in Philippine time?



13. What hourly rate are you expecting?



14. What makes you different from other VA applicants?



Attention Check



At the beginning of your application, write:



“I can help ProClean365 find commercial cleaning opportunities.”



Applications without this sentence may not be considered.



Our Goal



We want to build a long-term relationship with someone who can eventually become a key member of our business development team.



If you are ambitious, organized, resourceful, and want to grow with a company rather than simply complete VA tasks, we want to hear from you.



Apply today.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (TikTok / Instagram Reels / Facebook) – Mortgage Business
description:
Short-Form Video Editor (TikTok / Instagram Reels /
) – Mortgage Business



About us

We're a mortgage business in the Toronto area (Canada). We post short educational videos about mortgages, hosted by an on-camera presenter who films scripts in batches. We need a reliable editor to turn the raw clips into clean, engaging short-form videos and post them on a consistent schedule.



What you'll do

- Edit 4 short videos per week (30–60 seconds each) from raw clips of our on-camera host, sent in batches

- Cut pauses and mistakes, add on-screen captions, text hooks, and background music using our CapCut template and brand colours

- When no host clips are available, create simple "faceless" videos (stock footage + on-screen text + voiceover) or photo carousels from scripts I provide, so we never miss a week

- Post each video to TikTok, Instagram Reels and
 with the caption and hashtags I provide

- Keep at least two weeks of finished videos scheduled ahead

- Send a short weekly report: videos posted, views, comments, and any DMs or questions from viewers



Requirements

- Experience editing vertical short-form video (please send 2–3 TikTok/Reels links you've edited)

- Comfortable with CapCut (or Premiere/VN)

- Able to find and use royalty-free stock footage and music

- Good English for captions and spelling

- Reliable with deadlines and communication



Schedule and pay

- About 5 hours per week, flexible hours

- USD $60 per month for 16 finished videos (about $3.75 per video), paid monthly

- Extra videos paid at the same per-video rate

- Long-term role if it works out



Paid trial

Shortlisted applicants will get one paid trial task (USD $5): edit one 60-second raw clip into a captioned vertical video.



How to apply

Start your application with the word "CAPTIONS" so I know you read this post. Include:

1. 2–3 links to short-form videos you've edited

2. Your weekly availability

3. Which editing app you use

Applications without video samples won't be considered.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA RESEARCH & PERFORMANCE ANALYST
description:
SOCIAL MEDIA RESEARCH & PERFORMANCE ANALYST

Health & Wellness Short-Form Video | Part-Time (20–25 hrs/week) | Remote | Long-Term



ABOUT US

We're a US health and wellness brand building one of the biggest short-form video accounts in hormones, weight loss, and longevity. We need a detail-obsessed analyst who finds what's working in our space every week, tracks every number on our own account, and tells us what to change next.



This is a research and analytics role, not a content-creation role. If you love spreadsheets, spotting patterns, and figuring out why something went viral, keep reading.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EVERY WEEK



1. Outlier Report

Monitor about 40 accounts we give you, plus new ones you find. Find the 20 best-performing reels of the week, ranked by outlier score (a reel's views divided by that account's typical views), not raw views. Log each one in our Google Sheet: link, account, followers, views, likes, comments, shares (if visible), length, and format.



2. Hooks & Transcripts

For the top 10, write down word for word the first sentence spoken and the on-screen text in the first 3 seconds. Then transcribe the full reel.



3. Swipe File

Save the top 10 reels into our Google Drive library, tagged by hook type and format. This is for internal reference only and is never reposted.



4. Comment Mining

Collect 20 real questions people are asking in the comments of top reels, copied word for word with the link.



5. Trend Scan

List any topic that 3 or more accounts posted about this week.



6. Competitor Ads

Check the Meta Ad Library for the brands we list. Record any ad that has been running for more than 30 days, with screenshots.



7. Performance Tracking & Weekly Optimization

Own our content tracker. Log every reel we post: topic, hook, format, and length. Update its stats at 24 hours, 7 days, and 30 days: views, average watch time, skip rate, 3-second hold, shares, saves, follows, and non-follower reach. Run a weekly test log, where we change one thing at a time.



Every Sunday, deliver a one-page memo:

- Our top 3 and bottom 3 reels, and what the winners have in common

- Which hook type won this week, and the trend over the last 4 weeks

- How our numbers compare with the top reels in our space

- 4 past reels worth re-posting with a new opening

- The ONE change you'd test next week

- Anything unusual (spikes, drops, a reel suddenly getting shared)



8. Cross-Posting

Post every approved reel to TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and
, and track the stats on each platform.



9. Content Ops

Organize video and subtitle files from our editor in Google Drive, and schedule approved posts in Meta Business Suite.



YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS

- Week 1: Enter every reel we've already posted into the tracker so we have a baseline.

- Weeks 1–4: Write a short SOP (a doc or Loom video) for every recurring task you do.



HOW WE WORK

- Weekly report and memo due every Monday, 8:00 AM Manila time

- A short daily update in Slack: what you did, what's next, and anything blocking you

- One 20-minute call each week: [Monday 9:00 AM Manila time]

- 20–25 hours per week, flexible outside the call



HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED

- The Monday report arrives on time every week

- Transcripts are word-for-word accurate

- Stories from your report make it onto our content slate

- Your recommended tests actually get run and move our numbers



REQUIREMENTS

- Strong written English, especially accurate transcription

- Very comfortable with Google Sheets (formulas, sorting, clean formatting)

- Uses Instagram and TikTok daily and understands Reels metrics

- Reliable internet and on-time delivery every single week

- Bonus: experience with social analytics or scraping tools (Apify, Social Blade, etc.) or the health/fitness space



PAY & GROWTH

[$X/month], paid via [method]. Paid trial week first. Pay review at 90 days, with room to grow into running our social analytics.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Write "OUTLIER" as the first word of your application.

2. Pick any creator in health or fitness. Compare two of their recent reels, one that did well and one that didn't, and explain in 5–6 sentences what you think made the difference.

Applications without both will not be reviewed.
